notes.title: Death from Above: Bomber Strikes Descend
notes.notes: [p]Greetings Legends,[/p][p] [/p][p]The battlefield just got deadlier. In our newest update, bomber spaceship strikes make their debut in LEGEND BATTLES, unleashing unpredictable laser-guided devastation that forces every squad to adapt—or be erased.[/p][p] [/p][p]Watch the bomber spaceship tear across the clouds, unleash a randomized spread of 3–6 laser-guided bombs, and hear the screeching roar as they fall before turning red zones into burning craters.[/p][previewyoutube="RfQh1iCkjfU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]1. What Are Bomber Strikes?[/b][/p][p]At random moments during a match, the sky trembles as a bomber spaceship pierces the clouds. Seconds later, it unleashes 3 to 6 precision laser-guided bombs onto a glowing red circle on the map. Each blast rocks the arena with catastrophic force, vaporizing anything caught in its radius.[/p][p]This isn’t just a random danger like PUBG’s Red Zone—it’s high-tech orbital warfare shaping the battlefield.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/7d38b447708f86e0b4e8c1e4e42429a4f1ff92a1.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]2. Bomber Strike Mechanics[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bomber Arrival: A deep hum builds in the sky, giving Legends just seconds to react.[/p][/*][*][p]Red Circle Warning: The impact zone appears on both the map and minimap, glowing crimson with danger.[/p][/*][*][p]Laser-Guided Payload: Between 3 and 6 bombs are deployed per run, each with explosive power equal to heavy ordnance.[/p][/*][*][p]Screeching Descent: As bombs fall, they emit a piercing screech—a terrifying audio cue that death is seconds away.[/p][/*][*][p]Unforgiving Accuracy: Unlike scattered shelling, these bombs lock into precise coordinates—making every strike a calculated death zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Safe Havens: Reinforced bunkers and solid buildings are the only true protection. Standing in the open is a death sentence.[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicle Risk: Even armored vehicles can be shredded instantly if caught in a strike.[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage Deactivation: Once the restricted play area shrinks to its last zones, bomber strikes are disabled to ensure final duels are fought on skill—not luck.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/db8e5a9dc8687651c3cdf3b51245a00a93cb1a45.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]3. Strategy & Survival[/b][/p][list][*][p]Timing is Everything: Never assume the strike will be light, sometimes only 3 bombs fall, other times 6 rain down in rapid succession.[/p][/*][*][p]Mask Your Moves: Use the thunderous blasts and screeching noise to mask footsteps, reloads, or sniper repositioning.[/p][/*][*][p]High-Risk Zones: Smart squads bait enemies into red circles, gambling on the bombs to finish the job.[/p][/*][*][p]Calculated Retreats: If a circle drops on your fight, it may be safer to withdraw and let the bombs decide the victor.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/5669f64427fe1be84bff23a8551d4fdc5f3467a2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]4. Why Bomber Strikes?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Dynamic Chaos – Randomized 3–6 bombs mean no two strikes are the same.[/p][/*][*][p]Lore Depth – It’s not nature, it’s orbital fleets directing war from above.[/p][/*][*][p]Tactical Pressure – The laser-guided precision punishes campers and forces squads to stay mobile.[/p][/*][*][p]Fair Final Showdown – With bombs disabled in the last circles, the ultimate duel remains a pure test of combat mastery.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/3599ea8c9d0ff41c1c3c3bd92c80fab27f3a2e82.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]5. Lore Hook: The War Above[/b][/p][p]Every bombing run is part of the larger story. Orbital fleets wage silent battles above the arena, their conflict spilling into the ground war below. The laser-guided payloads are not mistakes—they’re deliberate strikes meant to destabilize the fight, and you’re caught in the crossfire.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/dc3822a639747a5e52f172adbaa962fbfd6e4278.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Playtest Incoming[/b][/p][p]Bomber Strikes will debut in the upcoming Legend Battles Playtest. We want your feedback:[/p][list][*][p]Are 3–6 bombs too random or just right?[/p][/*][*][p]Is the screeching descent adding enough tension?[/p][/*][*][p]Should late-game bombers stay disabled or return in special events?[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Stay Alert, Stay Alive[/b][/p][p]In LEGEND BATTLES, even the skies can betray you. Laser-guided bombs from orbiting warships will test your survival instincts, punishing hesitation and rewarding quick thinking.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/cbfdbfcfa0a60a8ac3abfb92679d5ab981eab3bd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Will you use the chaos to rise as a Legend—or be erased by precision fire from the heavens?[/p][p] [/p][p]See you under the bombers, Legends.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][b]Let’s recap what’s waiting for you in your legendary battles:[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]What Are Bomber Strikes?[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/30d456ad8f5cb323fba96a1fd303dc975359ccb1.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Bomber Strike Mechanics[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/3463b3dd67b28ad4588f22090e77f9fbbb9eb0a2.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Strategy & Survival[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/e3d67e39ccbd6cc51359510aeca69cefe3dbfc1a.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Why Bomber Strikes?[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/392f11364cba93bf9a0bf879d0aa407c31c73e66.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Lore Hook: The War Above[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/f4598d01935d1f65016e43383d9ca723ffbfd65a.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Stay Alert, Stay Alive[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/f815f279c54e63be9d7e804c83c8bc5acbf634c2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Playtest Coming Soon[/b][/p][p]Dear Legends, Join us in the battle. notes.title: New K-Pop MetaHumans Emotes Arrive!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Legends![/p][p] [/p][p]We are beyond excited to unveil four brand-new emotes to Legend Battles, inspired by some of the most iconic K-Pop groups in the world today. These dances are rituals honoring Bellona, the Roman goddess of war, designed to channel her strength and help you claim victory on the battlefield.[/p][p] [/p][p]But that's not all — we’ve also gone all out in capturing the essence of K-Pop by using cutting-edge motion capture technology, the same used in Hollywood 3D animated movies, to ensure these emotes are as authentic as possible. And to make these emotes even more special, we’ve created a video and GIFs inspired by the MEOVV group and their "DROP TOP" song that we adore almost as much as we adore Bellona herself![/p][previewyoutube="Dipgrn4GYiI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Ritual Dances & Durations[/b][/p][p]Each emote represents a ritual dance to honor Bellona before and during your battle. These moves will get you pumped, powerful, and ready for any enemy in your path. The dances are inspired by K-Pop hits that have racked up tens or hundreds of millions of views on YouTube and are instantly recognizable.[/p][list][*][p]Emote 1 – Duration: 23 seconds Inspired by the MEOVV group and their hit "DROP TOP", this sharp, energetic dance will prepare you to dominate the battlefield.[/p][/*][*][p]Emote 2 – Duration: 38 seconds Inspired by (G)i-dle’s hit "Good Thing", this fluid and graceful dance will embody both power and precision.[/p][/*][*][p]Emote 3 – Duration: 40 seconds Inspired by the HUNTR/X group and their track "Golden", this bold and stylish dance reflects their rising presence in the K-Pop scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Emote 4 – Duration: 41 seconds Inspired by KATSEYE and their electric hit "Gnarly", this powerful and intense dance will give you a commanding presence on the battlefield.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/119ec385e2400ad6cfc45bb5cfa42e52a62efe19.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Brought to Life with Unreal Engine 5.6 & Motion Capture Technology[/b][/p][p]We are proud to say that these ritual dances were created using the latest Unreal Engine 5.6 technology, allowing us to capture the very essence of these K-Pop performances in stunning detail. We've utilized Metahumans, exclusive groom hair technology in Chaos 5.6, and designed all the exclusive clothing in Chaos 5.6 technologies to bring these emotes to life in ways you've never seen before.[/p][p]And here's something we’re extra proud of: The video and GIFs inspired by the MEOVV group’s "DROP TOP" song are entirely created within our Steam app, with no retouching, no sequencer, and no video tools. The 3D kinematic sequences you see are pure, raw performance footage, all rendered in-engine without external video editing. We are showcasing the power of our own game technology to honor these K-Pop legends.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/18c57ff09fc7f8e7baa13246855cfe8b672f2130.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Tribute to K-Pop Genius: MEOVV[/b][/p][p]As part of our tribute, we’d like to take a moment to mention that we are particularly inspired by the MEOVV group. Their members — Ella, Gawon, Sooin, Narin, and Anna — are the true geniuses of K-Pop music. We have paid homage to them in our latest update, crafting these dance emotes with the same level of care and detail that we would give to any true warriors of the art form. The MEOVV emote (inspired by their song "DROP TOP") has a special place in our hearts, and we can’t wait for you to see it in action![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/94dc33e6a9462929b02efee13284031960d51a21.png"][/img][/p][p][b]MetaHumans: Hyper-Realistic Characters in Legend Battles[/b][/p][p]One of the key technologies behind these emotes is MetaHumans, powered by Unreal Engine 5.6.[/p][list][*][p]What Are MetaHumans? MetaHumans are hyper-realistic digital characters, created with ultra-detailed textures, facial fidelity, and lifelike movement animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Why It Matters in Legend Battles In Legend Battles, we use MetaHuman technology to achieve stunning visual renderings of our characters. This allows for:[/p][/*][/list][olist][*][p]Realistic textures that capture even the smallest details of skin, hair, and clothing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fluid, lifelike animations enhanced by motion capture.[/p][/*][*][p]Very high graphical fidelity, letting you feel immersed in every performance and battle.[/p][/*][/olist][p]This is the same technology being adopted across film and next-gen games, and we are proud to bring it into Legend Battles for the most realistic and immersive experience possible.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/b21583ddf29dc4f416b307e3eb5e8015dca3ca17.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Availability[/b][/p][p]These fantastic new emotes will be available with our next update, and you’ll be able to unlock them through the in-game store or via special events. We are excited to hear your feedback, as we plan to bring these K-Pop legends into the battlefield as playable characters in the future — based entirely on your comments and the energy you bring to the game.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Join the Dance of War![/b][/p][p]We want to see how you use these powerful emotes in your battles! Share your best clips, screenshots, and dance battles with the community by tagging #LegendBattlesDance. Whether you're honoring Bellona or celebrating a well-earned victory, show us how you perform these ritual dances inspired by the biggest K-Pop hits today.[/p][p] [/p][p]Dance like a warrior. Honor Bellona and K-Pop’s finest.[/p][p]Victory belongs to those who perform with power and passion.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you on the battlefield, Legends![/p][p] [/p][p]— The Legend Battles Team[/p][p]

notes.title: The Sky Falls, Airdrops Await, Grab Your Gear!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Legends,[/p][p] [/p][p]The skies have opened up, and now, more than ever, the battlefield is about to get a whole lot more unpredictable! LEGEND BATTLES’ airdrops are a game-changing mechanic that brings high-stakes loot and intense combat to the skies above. Whether you're hunting for rare gear, upgrading your squad’s arsenal, or looking for a tactical edge, airdrops are now your new best friend (or your worst enemy).[/p][p] [/p][p]Get ready for a step-by-step guide to how these drops work in LEGEND BATTLES, and how you can turn them into your ticket to victory.[/p][previewyoutube="8koHsHZaa_I;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]1. The Airdrop Signal - Marking the Start of a New Battle[/b][/p][p]Airdrops don’t just appear out of nowhere. The first thing you’ll notice is a distinctive audio cue and a flare of light in the sky. A bright signal will pierce through the chaos of battle, announcing the arrival of an airdrop.[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Audio Cue: The thunderous rumble and crackle of its thrusters, from the high-velocity exhaust gases colliding with the air, will alert you when the spacecraft flies at low altitude.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Visual Cue: A glowing beacon will appear in the sky. It’s your signal to prepare—an airdrop is inbound.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Random Airdrop: The spaceship's direction is stable, allowing players to plan their approach, but the drop zones vary from match to match and are random.[/p][/*][/list][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/6f24792b1092362265e1b4d8e8f1d55817b6db5f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]2. Tracking the Drop Zone[/b][/p][p]Once the airdrop signal activates, keep your eyes on the sky. The spaceship carrying the crate will fly over, and the airdrop will descend but the location is not market on the map.[/p][p] [/p][p]Important: The drop location is random within the match zone, and it could be anywhere on the map, so don’t get too comfortable in one place. You’ll need to act fast because other players will be gunning for it too.[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Bright Signal: The airdrop glows brightly, making it visible to all players within a large radius.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Limited Time: Keep an eye on the timing. Once the signal goes off, the crate will only stay in the air for a limited time before it lands.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Crowded Convergence: Players have to adapt quickly since multiple players will be converging at the same location.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Late Clash: Airdrops can sometimes even drop behind safe zones, leading to intense late-game confrontations.[/p][/*][/list][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/d3aa6175f0f1732c69d6f2114cb7bcda3db8f9e6.png"][/img][/p][p][b]3. Airdrop Contents – What’s Inside the Crate?[/b][/p][p]Airdrops contain special loot that can change the course of a battle. These aren’t your usual items. We’re talking about rare weapons, high-tier armor, special grenades, and even game-changing equipment.[/p][p] [/p][p]Here’s a breakdown of what you might find:[/p][list][*][p]Epic Weapons: Think assault rifles, sniper rifles, and SMGs with special attachments you won’t find anywhere else.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Powerful Weapons: Take grenade launchers, miniguns, flamethrowers.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tactical Gear: Grab level 3 helmets and vests, health kits, and smoke grenades.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Special Equipment: Wear a hazmat suit for camouflage or protection against radiation storms.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/c5b378ae07d336adc116f568dcb5824eaadadcf0.png"][/img][/p][p][b]4. The Drop – Be the First to Reach It[/b][/p][p]Now comes the critical moment: the drop zone becomes obvious, and it’s time to go for it. But beware, other players are thinking the same thing.[/p][p] [/p][p]Here’s what you need to know to grab that crate:[/p][list][*][p]Race to the Drop Zone: The crate will soon, but you need to be fast. If you're too slow, other squads might beat you to it.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Defend the Drop: Once the crate lands, it will be a high-risk, high-reward situation. Everyone in the area will likely converge on it so it will turn into an all-out combat zone.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Smoke Grenades: Use the airdrop crate as a shield and throw smoke grenades all around it so snipers can't target you while you loot the airdrop.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/5190448fa6ec7b2445467705448dbc6b6eb6067c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]5. Red Smoke – The Airdrop Has Landed![/b][/p][p]Once the airdrop crate hits the ground, it’s not just about the loot, it’s also about the red smoke that rises from the crate. The moment the crate touches down, bright red smoke erupts from the ground, marking the location for all players nearby.[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Red Smoke Mechanics: This red smoke serves as an immediate signal that the crate has been deployed and is up for grabs. It will remain in the air for a while, giving you a clear indication of the crate's position.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]High Alert: Be aware, red smoke doesn’t just mark the location for you, it also alerts enemy players to the drop. Once you see that red cloud, get ready for a potential firefight.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Cover for the Bold: If you're quick and strategic, you can use the red smoke as cover for your approach, especially if you have smoke grenades to throw off enemies trying to sniper you from afar.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/64f19434f5b057eca322ad8f6db38e976ee6c683.png"][/img][/p][p][b]6. Secure the Airdrop – Lock and Load[/b][/p][p]You’ve reached the crate, but the fight doesn’t stop here. Securing the airdrop is just the first step. The moment you open the crate, the contents will be yours to use, but you may not be alone. Players nearby will be on high alert and may come rushing in.[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Loot Quickly: The loot menu will open automatically once you interact with the crate, giving you a few precious seconds to grab what you need.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Inventory Limitations: Be mindful of your inventory space. Airdrops contain so much high-quality loot, so it’s important to choose wisely. Don't be afraid to drop low-tier gear.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Be prepared to defend yourself: Protect yourself by taking cover before accessing the crate because the looting process is long, so manage your time strategically.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/193bd5d7288fb8dcc136a130dc626971ac95eaec.png"][/img][/p][p][b]7. The Airdrop Controversy – Everyone Wants a Piece[/b][/p][p]Airdrops are public knowledge, meaning that every player on the map knows about the drop once the signal activates. That means the drop zone will become a hotspot of competition.[/p][p] [/p][p]Strategies to Consider:[/p][list][*][p]Stealth Approach: Don’t just rush in, wait and observe. Watch the drop zone from a distance and see if others arrive first. If they do, ambush them while they’re distracted.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]High Tension: Multiple teams can land at an airdrop and engage in fierce firefights. The proximity of enemy teams creates high tension.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Team Play: Squad up! Airdrops are best handled with good communication. Your team can cover different angles while one person grabs the loot.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/1a3d37fa6cb64d6c6831f3622ee5c327b2097a20.png"][/img][/p][p][b]8. Final Thoughts: Will You Be the One to Secure the Airdrop?[/b][/p][p]In LEGEND BATTLES, every decision matters, and nothing shakes up the battlefield quite like the arrival of a high-value airdrop. Will you rush in and risk it all, or will you bide your time and strike when your enemies are vulnerable? The choice is yours.[/p][p]As always, legends, the skies are watching, will you seize the loot or fall to the storm?[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Stay sharp, Legends.[/p][p]Get ready to dominate the battlefield with rare gear and the perfect tactical advantage. notes.title: LEGEND BATTLES on Global Stage at CIFTIS 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hi Legends,[/p][p] [/p][p]We’ve just returned from an incredible experience at CIFTIS 2025 — the China International Fair for Trade in Services — one of the world’s largest service trade exhibitions, held September 10–14 at the stunning Shougang Park in Beijing, co-hosted by the Ministry of Commerce of China and the Beijing Municipal Government.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/b0bb21f9bc2fecc7512a0e24980820aa75cc3f5b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our CTO, Eric Mergy, also serving as AI advisor for smart cities, was honored to deliver a keynote in plenary session at the “New Tech Scenarios, Activating New Consumption” forum. The talk focused on how gaming is becoming more than entertainment — it’s evolving into a bridge for cultural exchange, digital tourism, and technological innovation.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/7659ccdfff43dc6038493e71ad8a3af902effbde.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our President and CEO, Dr. Jianglin Zhang, also serving as the President of the Data Center of Ministry of Culture and Tourism, International Tourism Data Joint Laboratory, was invited by the Ministry of Commerce of China as a VIP guest of honor in the front row.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/3ba1c0c425f8695e1293a8eb81190cd865c1ccdd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][u]Games as Culture
[/u]Eric emphasized that modern games are no longer just play. They’re a global digital stage combining storytelling, interactivity, art, and cutting-edge tech. Games now serve as new cultural carriers, connecting communities worldwide with the power of immersion and interactivity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/00f733ec1a1af19cccee1aef9f5ae6d262dd99e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][u]Spotlight on LEGEND BATTLES
[/u]During the keynote, we introduced LEGEND BATTLES, our next-generation hyper-realistic free-to-play battle royale. Built with Unreal Engine 5.6 and powered by AWS GameLift, it features:[/p][p]· A 400 km² mountainous desert battlefield.[/p][p]· Thousands of fully explorable buildings (yes, interiors and rooftops!).[/p][p]· Dynamic weather systems, advanced vehicles, and interchangeable clothing systems.[/p][p]· AI-driven metahuman locomotion and tactical shooter mechanics.[/p][p]· Cloud computing and real-time network communication for massive-scale battles.[/p][p] [/p][p]This is not just a multiplayer shooter. Our vision is to turn LEGEND BATTLES into a digital ecosystem platform that integrates cultural and tourism resources — bringing the richness of world culture and beyond into a global gaming arena.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/8fab9dfc8e6de7ca589563eb7332589ee8551c1a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][u]Why It Matters
[/u]At an event that attracts thousands of companies and hundreds of thousands of visitors worldwide, LEGEND BATTLES stood out as an example of how games can be a driving force in the future of digital services, culture, and intelligent technologies.[/p][p]We’re thrilled to see LEGEND BATTLES gaining attention not only as a competitive game but also as a new medium of cultural storytelling.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/64c881c946ea1f5ba3850c89f5ae621ce4c5ef15.png"][/img][/p][p]Add LEGEND BATTLES to your Steam Wishlist and follow us on Steam to stay tuned for the official Playtest date and patch notes![/p][p] [/p][p]Squad up, share tactics, win rewards, join the official LEGEND BATTLES Discord today! notes.title: Quantum Barrels, Teleportation, Time Travel
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Legends,[/p][p] [/p][p]In LEGEND BATTLES, the Future of Survival Awaits. The battlefield is alive, shrinking, shifting, and demanding every ounce of strategy.[/p][previewyoutube="aI9xzglx4OM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][list][*][p]Master the Playzone – Outsmart the ever-closing circle before it consumes you.[/p][/*][*][p]Harness the Five Elements – Collect Quantum Barrels to fuel teleportation and unlock legendary rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Teleport Across Worlds – Travel instantly between Bellona and Aurora, but beware: the hubs are deadly ambush grounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Defy Death – Recover fallen allies through Respawn Machines, summon the legendary Yellow Hover Taxi, and parachute your squadmates back into the fight.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Every match is more than a battle—it’s a story of survival, loyalty, and second chances.[/p][p][b]Fall. Be carried. Descend. Fight again.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/b70ed3842e6a58f63c52b2f919b1c7034a19ab1a.png"][/img][/p][p]The world of LEGEND BATTLES is more than just a battlefield—it’s a living arena where technology, mysticism, and survival collide. Every match is a test not only of your combat skills, but of your ability to master the powers of quantum barrels, manipulate teleportation hubs, and even bend time itself through the mysterious respawn machines.[/p][p] [/p][p]And when fate calls you back from beyond, nothing feels more legendary than parachuting from a driverless yellow hover taxi, returning to fight alongside your squad. Prepare yourselves, for the future of battle is here.[/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]1. Shrinking Playzone – Outsmart the Battlefield[/b][/u][/p][p] [/p][p]Survival in LEGEND BATTLES is more than just shooting straight—it’s about mastering the Playzone, the invisible hand that pushes every warrior closer together.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Purpose: Why the Playzone Shrinks[/b]
The ever-tightening battlefield ensures that no match dissolves into endless hiding. Each contraction raises the stakes, forcing players into decisive encounters and keeping the action unrelenting.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Visuals: Reading the Circles[/b]
On your minimap, the Playzone appears as two glowing rings:[/p][list][*][p][b]White Circle[/b] → the next safe zone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blue Circle[/b] → the current boundary closing in.[/p][/*][/list][p]Ignore them at your peril.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/32342bbbbb02592eec3f6d83912d8cde2d155e3a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Damage: The Price of Falling Behind[/b]
Step outside the blue, and reality itself will punish you. Damage begins light in the early phases but intensifies until hesitation means instant death. Only the prepared—with healing and boosting items—can survive its bite.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Shrinking Rate: Always Shifting[/b]
No two matches shrink the same way. Some zones give you breathing space to reposition; others slam shut, forcing desperate sprints. Adaptability is your only constant ally.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Circle Mechanics: Beyond Random Chance[/b][/p][list][*][p]The first circle is born randomly at match start, ensuring each battle is unique.[/p][/*][*][p]Later zones build dynamically from the last, calculated with hidden factors that keep every match unpredictable.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/98821079cc8abd1644656bd4c2cbee4e1f505821.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Five Stages, Five Rewards: Quantum Barrels Await[/b]
Each of the five shrinking stages reveals a distinct type of quantum barrel, tied to the eternal cycle of Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water. These symbols of elemental power are scattered across the battlefield—collected not for immediate gain, but as currency and proof of mastery.[/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]2. Quantum Barrels – The Five Elements of Power[/b][/u][/p][p] [/p][p]Quantum barrels are no mere loot—they are the lifeblood of LEGEND BATTLES’ sci-fi economy.[/p][p] [/p][p]Each barrel aligns with an element:[/p][list][*][p]Red quantun barrel for Fire.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/fe1de74f4532e373c2832cb5d8c95c2765d9d545.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Yellow quantun barrel for Earth.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/1608c92d9f2a41ebd8b1f367a7e904f8f4aa2ef0.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Silver quantun barrel for Metal.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/f836b159450fcb9d30ed3a403bbf8cf968ec0899.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Blue quantun barrel for Water.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/219814d1921231ae3538c6f12458c5e40637edde.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Green quantun barrel for Wood.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/cbd52996c33474f08c7f7841aa2dba11ceb91e0c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Collection Rules:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Only one element type appears per Playzone stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Across five stages, heroes can gather all five—if they survive.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Their Purpose:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Teleportation Currency[/b]: Pay a barrel to access teleport stations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Endgame Jackpot[/b]: Deliver one of each element and win the session to unlock massive rewards in points and Battle Coins.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Prestige & Power[/b]: Barrels unlock legendary gear, rare skins, and vehicles—items tradeable at premium value on the Steam Community Market.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/b2b0e82a37c6a907981ddd74d72cf77066cba183.png"][/img][/p][p]In short: barrels are status, strategy, and survival all in one.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]3. Teleport Centers, Stations and Gates – Tear Open Spacev[/u][/b][/p][p] [/p][p]In the sprawling worlds of Bellona and Aurora, movement decides fate. The introduction of teleport centers, stations and gates changes everything, no longer must warriors trudge for minutes through hostile terrain. With barrels in hand, you bend space itself.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]What is a Teleport Hub?[/b]
A network of fast-travel platforms linking key regions. They allow near-instant relocation—but at a cost, and with risk.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/6d88f022cc7e18b8bf74e62d2496356dc7b44265.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Two Types of Teleport Hubs:[/b][/p][p]• Teleport Centers: Hidden in mountain hearts beyond ominous caverns and their cost is 2 quantum barrels. They can teleport on long distances to centers, stations and gates.[/p][p]• Teleport Stations: Found near cyberpunk villages and alien forests and their cost is 1 quantum barrel. They can teleport on short distances to centers, stations and gates.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/db64ccf3356b334207537b7426d726e03a7848ca.png"][/img][/p][p][b]What are Teleport Gates?[/b][/p][p]These are exit-only portals that provide an immediate, one-way exit from teleport centers and stations. Unlike the teleport centers and stations, they do not require quantum barrels and are often hidden in the surrounding environment, allowing for a quick escape or a surprise flank. They are a free but high-risk alternative to controlled travel.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/acf7e30171269c9385eaa6f5bce973494952a69f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Risk:[/b]
Hubs are natural killzones. Snipers and ambushers wait for careless travelers. To teleport is to gamble—victory or death.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Rewards:[/b][/p][p][b]1. Speed[/b] – Less travel, more battle.[/p][p][b]2. Exploration[/b] – Venture into unknown zones with safety nets.[/p][p][b]3. Teamplay[/b] – Reunite with allies across vast maps.[/p][p][b]4. Accessibility[/b] – A guidepost for newcomers overwhelmed by sprawling landscapes.[/p][p] [/p][p]Teleport centers, stations and gates aren’t convenience; they are strategic weapons. Learn to wield them or risk being outmaneuvered.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/94e66b08e791bbb1ecc3b5d92febd7e86d56da4b.png"][/img][/p][p][u][b]4. Respawn Machines – Defy Death Itself[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p]In LEGEND BATTLES, even death bends to technology. The Respawn System offers fallen warriors a second chance, if their allies have the courage to act.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]The Player Chip – Carrying Their Soul[/b]
When you fall, you leave behind a Player Chip. Teammates who recover it carry your essence—and your hope—toward resurrection.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/70212477f98bd77cfdf70a43a868aea5dbc9e1d7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Respawn Stations – Monuments of Time[/b]
Towering sci-fi machines scattered across the battlefield, capable of bending reality itself.[/p][list][*][p][b]Activation[/b]: Deliver the chip to begin the process.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Time Travel[/b]: The machine pulls your teammate’s essence back from the past into the present.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tactical Value[/b]: Rare, contested, and always dangerous to approach.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Squad Salvation[/b]: A single activation can turn despair into triumph.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/07176802136b71a224653d8b2315c6adc8f8b9b2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Skyborn Return – By Hover Taxi[/b]
Respawns are not silent—they are spectacular.[/p][list][*][p][b]Yellow Hover Taxi[/b]: The legendary driverless cab descends from the clouds, carrying your ally from the timestream.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Parachute Drop[/b]: From the hover taxi, the revived player leaps back into the fight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Landing Zones[/b]: Choose wisely—into cover, into your squad’s arms, or into loot-heavy danger.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fresh Start[/b]: Returned with minimal gear, survival depends on scavenging and teamwork.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]“The wind roared in my ears as I fell. No gun, no armor—only a heartbeat and a second chance.”[/i]
— Revived Combatant Testimony[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/7eac7bf4bf0b1661493a21b963bde070e254607e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Limits of Resurrection[/b]
Respawns work only in the earlier phases. Once the final circles collapse, the stations shut down forever. Beyond that, death has no undoing.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Strategy Around Respawn[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Chip Runs[/b]: Decide whether to risk recovery under fire.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Station Control[/b]: Holding one can swing the match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Safe Descent[/b]: Guide revived allies back into strength.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]A Fight Beyond Death[/b]
Every chip carried, every station defended, every hover taxi ride, every parachute descent—it all tells a story of loyalty and defiance. In LEGEND BATTLES, even the laws of time bow to those who refuse to surrender.[/p][p][i]“Death is not the end here. It is the sky, the fall, and the fire that follows.”[/i]
— Inscription on a Respawn Terminal[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/0e2f2c833aff3b39bd9cf80078e68957a4b88102.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Conclusion – Will You Master the Future of Battle?[/b][/p][p]Quantum barrels, teleport hubs, respawn machines, hover taxis—each mechanic in [b]LEGEND BATTLES[/b] is a thread in a grand design. Together, they transform every match into a saga of survival, strategy, and spectacle.[/p][p][/p][p]Are you ready to adapt, outsmart the Playzone, harness the five elements, tear through space, and return from the brink of oblivion?[/p][p][/p][p]Fall. Be carried. Descend. Fight again. In LEGEND BATTLES, even the sky remembers your name.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Let’s recap what’s waiting for you in your legendary battles:[/u][/p][p] [/p][p]• Playzone[/p][p]A shrinking battlefield with unpredictable dynamics.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/be4d965499c5711fa99bdf19ad739008dd00eeae.gif"][/img][/p][p]
• Quantum Barrels[/p][p]Harness the quantum barrels of the five elemental powers during each stage of playzone shrinkage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/257e410deeb22f626f39bda87470bc768212f319.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]• Teleport Center[/p][p]Long-distance travel from this center costs 2 quantum barrels.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/e63e96b55032ec6e5c4e965a5a610918fa9e1958.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]• Teleport Station[/p][p]Short-distance jumps from this station cost 1 quantum barrel.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ed7db9976fd59289f1bbd5658812758242b434f7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]• Teleport Gate[/p][p]Exit portal from a teleport center or a teleport station.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/d5762a6f385e33c14046992d3d72579698b1ca90.gif"][/img][/p][p]
• Respawn[/p][p]Time-travel machines bring fallen teammates back to life from the past into the present.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/8da540bd0f0bcebdff55c1db3b859a0a12b234d1.gif"][/img][/p][p]
• Parachute Drop[/p][p]Respawned teammates re-enter the battlefield via a yellow air taxi.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/daa945eafcc5ce3a087cb51303ee04f88baf81d5.gif"][/img][/p][p]
• Protection[/p][p]Cover your returning teammates quickly. notes.title: LEGEND BATTLES harnesses cutting-edge tech to redefine multiplayer gaming
notes.notes: [p]Greetings Legends,[/p][p] [/p][p]As the gaming landscape continues to evolve, LEGEND BATTLES stands at the forefront of next-gen multiplayer experiences. Combining the best of cloud infrastructure, real-time rendering technology, and AI-powered performance optimization, LEGEND BATTLES is more than just a game— it’s an immersive, high-performance, hyper-realistic, large-scale world of 400 km2 with hundreds of megacities whose thousands of buildings all have interiors, thus setting a new standard for online multiplayer Battle Royale gaming apps.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are thrilled to share an in-depth look into the powerful technologies behind LEGEND BATTLES, and how cutting-edge technologies from AWS GameLift, Epic Online Services, Unreal Engine 5.6, and NVIDIA DLSS 4 (optional) come together to offer players a rich, dynamic, and seamless next generation multiplayer gameplay.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/7183a6690fbd4013836d9c4422147c642917fc6f.png"][/img][/p][p][u]AWS GameLift: Scalable and Resilient Multiplayer Infrastructure[/u][/p][p]Behind the seamless, low-latency multiplayer experience in LEGEND BATTLES is AWS GameLift—Amazon Web Services' flagship tool for deploying multiplayer games at scale. As we’ve developed LEGEND BATTLES, we’ve relied on AWS GameLift to provide the best possible service for players around the world:[/p][list][*][p]Global Coverage: AWS’s infrastructure spans across multiple continents, allowing LEGEND BATTLES to deliver near-instantaneous connection times regardless of where players are located. Whether you're in North America, Europe, Asia, or beyond, you’ll experience smooth, fast gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Low Latency and Responsiveness: One of the biggest challenges for online multiplayer games is ensuring low latency, especially as the player base grows. AWS GameLift minimizes lag by automatically routing players to the nearest available game servers. This means that no matter where your battle takes you, the experience remains fluid and responsive.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/d2d26a32ed190d31b8ce51ab1e1b94d303c1b4bd.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Predictive Autoscaling: One of the standout features of AWS GameLift is its predictive autoscaling. Using machine learning, GameLift forecasts player demand and dynamically adjusts server capacity in real time. When thousands of players suddenly flood into the game for a major update, GameLift ensures that servers scale up efficiently, maintaining a consistent experience even during peak hours. When traffic dips, GameLift automatically scales down, ensuring that resources are used efficiently and that costs are kept under control.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Flexible Matchmaking: For LEGEND BATTLES, matchmaking is key to ensuring every player is placed in a fair, challenging match. Using FlexMatch, GameLift handles complex matchmaking by taking into account multiple factors: player skill, location, playstyle, and even ping times. This guarantees that each match is well-balanced and optimized for the most enjoyable experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]AWS GameLift provides the robust backbone necessary to host LEGEND BATTLES’ worldwide multiplayer battles—scaling dynamically, ensuring low-latency, and creating fair matchmaking that caters to every type of player.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/d5f2ded3009288267ce4d9e50c691cca4967d327.png"][/img][/p][p][u]Epic Online Services: Communication and Fair Play in Cross-Platform Multiplayer[/u][/p][p]In LEGEND BATTLES, we understand that communication is crucial to success, whether you're coordinating with a team or trying to outwit your opponents. That’s why we’ve integrated Epic Online Services (EOS)—a suite of powerful tools that enhance player interaction, ensure fair play, and simplify cross-platform connectivity:[/p][list][*][p]Cross-Platform Voice Chat: The ability to communicate with teammates is essential in any multiplayer game. EOS provides a fully integrated voice chat system that works across all platforms, from PC to consoles (console apps are not implemented yet). Players can easily connect with their squadmates for coordinated gameplay without the need for third-party apps or services. Whether you’re on PlayStation, Xbox, or PC, the voice chat system ensures your communication is always seamless and high-quality.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Easy Anti-Cheat: Maintaining the integrity of every match is crucial in competitive games. That’s why LEGEND BATTLES uses Easy Anti-Cheat from Epic Games. With this robust anti-cheat system, we can prevent common forms of cheating, such as aimbots, wallhacks, and exploits, ensuring that every match is fair and competitive. Easy Anti-Cheat is already a trusted tool used in many top-tier competitive games, making it an ideal choice for LEGEND BATTLES.[/p][/*][/list][p]Together, Epic Online Services brings players closer through crystal-clear voice chat, while ensuring that everyone has a fair and balanced playing field.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/10d215962059e719a350213fd26d61365ada0c67.png"][/img][/p][p][u]Unreal Engine 5.6: The Next Generation of Gaming Visuals and Physics[/u][/p][p]When it comes to bringing the 400 km2 world of LEGEND BATTLES to life, Unreal Engine 5.6 is the engine that powers our stunning visuals and complex game mechanics. The combination of advanced rendering techniques, dynamic environments, and immersive physics makes the world of LEGEND BATTLES feel alive and responsive:[/p][list][*][p]World Partition: The massive, open-world maps in LEGEND BATTLES are made possible by World Partition, a feature that automatically loads and streams only the necessary portions of the world. This allows players to traverse vast landscapes—up to 400 km²—without the need for loading screens. Whether you're fighting in a bustling city or scaling a rugged mountain range, the environment is always ready for exploration.[/p][/*][*][p]It's important to remember that the [i]Legend Battles[/i] team has a proven track record in creating expansive, detailed 3D environments. Their previous 3D world map and navigation app ranked #3 in China on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. With this experience in handling large-scale, immersive worlds, a 400 km² map is well within their expertise.[/p][/*][*][p]MetaHumans: Characters in LEGEND BATTLES are crafted using MetaHumans, a revolutionary framework by Epic Games that enables the creation of ultra-realistic human characters. With MetaHumans, we’re able to create stunningly detailed characters that feature advanced facial animations (available later), natural expressions, and highly accurate skin and hair textures with millions of interchangeable clothes.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/6ced1a0f1d34335b367e674e8561a236dcec2b04.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Lumen Global Illumination: Lighting plays a pivotal role in immersion, and with Lumen, Unreal Engine 5.6 delivers dynamic global illumination. Real-time lighting reacts to everything from time of day to player actions. If you shoot out a light in a dark cave or ignite a fire on the battlefield, you’ll see realistic reflections and shadows dynamically interact with the world.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Nanite Virtualized Geometry: The Nanite technology allows us to use incredibly detailed assets—such as complex textures, geometric structures, and massive environments—without sacrificing performance. This makes it possible to deliver truly cinematic visuals with no compromise on frame rates, creating a sense of scale and realism that’s never been possible before.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/f60a6b5e26dc5c31d40c8e582a6a453d7d8a3722.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Chaos Physics creates a dynamic, destructible world where fences collapse, windows shatter, doors are smashed, balusters crumble, and each explosion reshapes the environment. Vehicles lose their bumpers, doors, hoods, trunks, wheels explode, windows fly apart, windshields shatter, the engine and fuel tank catch fire from gunfire and then explode. The Cloth Simulation makes capes, banners, and robes ripple and react to movement and wind, adding realism to characters’ attire. Hair and Fur respond to movement and environmental forces, creating lifelike, fluid animation for both characters and creatures.[/p][/*][*][p]MetaSounds powers the game to deliver dynamic and contextual sound that adapts to player actions and environmental changes, ensuring a truly immersive experience. Every element—from physical reactions to soundscapes—brings the world of LEGEND BATTLES to life.[/p][p]With Unreal Engine 5.6, we’ve created a world that is not only visually stunning but also reactive and engaging in ways never seen before in multiplayer games.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ec7a56104e64e9fc1f92ff708e4f631592bd2a77.png"][/img][/p][p][u]NVIDIA DLSS 4: AI-Enhanced Graphics and Performance (optional)[/u][/p][p]To ensure that LEGEND BATTLES not only looks great but plays smoothly at the highest frame rates, we’ve integrated NVIDIA DLSS 4 for NVIDIA RTX 20, 30, 40, and 50 series GPUs. This AI-powered upscaling technology provides a performance boost while maintaining ultra-high image quality, making it ideal for high-resolution gaming:[/p][list][*][p]Multi-Frame Generation: DLSS 4 introduces a breakthrough Multi-Frame Generation feature, where the AI generates additional frames between rendered ones, boosting performance by up to 8×. This allows LEGEND BATTLES to run smoothly at higher resolutions (including 4K) without a hit to visual quality, making high-end, ray-traced experiences more accessible to players with demanding setups.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Ray Tracing at High Frame Rates: DLSS 4 works in tandem with real-time ray tracing to offer stunning reflections, lighting, and shadows—while maintaining a consistent frame rate. Whether you’re battling in a detailed environment or zooming across a huge map, DLSS ensures that you never compromise on visual quality or performance.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/89ffd294c5224f002ae668b3037472c6b81339ea.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]AI Motion Clarity and Ghosting Reduction: The AI-powered motion clarity in DLSS 4 ensures that fast-moving objects, such as characters, vehicles, and projectiles, remain crisp and clear even at high speeds. It effectively reduces ghosting and blurring, ensuring that players experience smooth, immersive action.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Optimized Memory Usage: DLSS 4 reduces GPU memory consumption by up to 30%, allowing for higher-resolution textures, more on-screen entities, and expansive draw distances—ideal for large-scale battles like LEGEND BATTLES.[/p][/*][/list][p]With DLSS 4, we can deliver high-quality visuals without sacrificing gameplay performance—giving players the best of both worlds and it’s optional.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/4eb9c9bf86d5bc5b9fcba930c01f347a2754fe67.png"][/img][/p][p][u]In closing[/u][/p][p]This is only the beginning.[/p][p]LEGEND BATTLES is not just a showcase of current-gen technology—it’s built for the future. With scalable infrastructure, cutting-edge graphics, dynamic physics, and intelligent systems, we’re prepared to evolve this world alongside the community.[/p][p]Whether you’re a warrior, a tactician, a role-player, or a world-builder—your legend begins here.[/p][p]Thank you for standing with us as we forge ahead into battle.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/e8b0a221cbc1fe997d9b7813a4e1df56455a693b.png"][/img][/p][p]So, dear Legends, come join our ranks, participate in the tough test battles during future Playtest sessions, add LEGEND BATTLES to your Wishlist and follow us now on STEAM to loudly and clearly affirm your support for our fight.[/p][p] [/p][p]— The Legend Battles Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Player contact:[url="https://support@legendbattles.com"]support@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Media contact:[url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Partner contact:[url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Official website:[url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p]

Unlock your cosmetics: Select your cosmetics one by one among a large variety of cosmetics for the same season.[/p][p]3. Resell your cosmetics: Sell your items on the STEAM Marketplace and profit from your collection![/p][p] [/p][p]The 6 Exciting Season Passes in LEGEND BATTLES:
We’re launching with six distinct Season Passes, each packed with exclusive cosmetics. Here’s a look at the themes:[/p][p]1. Chinese New Year Season Pass: Celebrate with dragon armor, gold-plated weapons, and silk-draped vehicles.[/p][p]3. Camouflage Season Pass: Gear up in elite war outfits with realistic camouflage and tactical equipment.[/p][p]4. Pirate Season Pass: Wear pirate-themed cosmetics with ghost captains, tricorn hats, and cannon shotguns.[/p][p]5. Skull Season Pass: Go dark and gothic with bone armor, cursed shotguns, and skeletal motorcycles.[/p][p]6. Fruit Season Pass: Embrace the absurdity with fruit-themed warfare — from watermelon shotguns to kiwi mini cars.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/8c7e968e54dd45a567fea208d732d9a811d1f913.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Battle Pass vs. Season Pass: What’s the Difference?[/p][p]While the Season Pass focuses on unlocking exclusive seasonal cosmetics and reselling them for profit, the Battle Pass is all about achieving in-game milestones and unlocking exceptional rewards through time and effort. Here’s how the two differ:[/p][p] [/p][p]Battle Pass Features:[/p][list][*][p]Time-limited progression: Available for a specific season and offering exclusive rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Tiered rewards: Earn XP, complete challenges, and unlock rewards as you level up.[/p][/*][*][p]Free Track: A limited set of rewards available for all players.[/p][/*][*][p]Premium Track (Paid): Unlock exclusive, higher-value cosmetics for a small fee.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Premium Battle Pass Perks:[/p][list][*][p]Outstanding Cosmetics: Rare skins, weapons, and vehicles for true customization.[/p][/*][*][p]In-Game Currency: Premium Battle Passes often reward you with Legend Coins to buy even more cosmetics.[/p][/*][*][p] Faster Progression: Enjoy XP boosts to progress more quickly through tiers.[/p][/*][*][p]New Content: Sometimes, Season Passes grant early access to new MetaHumans, outfits, weapons, and vehicles.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot Boxes: Get Bravo Packs and Alpha Packs containing random cosmetics.[/p][/*][*][p]Discounts: Some Premium passes offer discounts on in-game items.[/p][/*][*][p]Exclusive Perks: Such as bonus legendary items, more fuel for vehicles, and access to exclusive events.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Season Pass Sub-Passes:[/p][p]Each Season Pass is divided into three sub-passes offering distinct categories of cosmetics:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/fa7bebe57d2103666f85513ac3dfb2c35948e24f.png"][/img][/p][p]1.
