notes.title: Millions of hyper-realistic clothing combos
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Braves,
[/p][p]In LEGEND BATTLES, clothing isn't just cosmetic, it affects your [b]visibility[/b], [b]mobility[/b], [b]camouflage[/b], and [b]player perception[/b]. From tactical functions to visual revolutions, LEGEND BATTLES launches "hyper-realistic combat uniforms": clothing is not simply a "skin", but a multi-dimensional system that integrates tactical functions, team logos, and market value.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ZqGPemIJC84;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p]1. LEGEND BATTLES is Unreal Engine 5.6[/p][p]Nanite 5.6 micro details:[/p][p]Real-time rendering of fabric fibers with their embroidery and stitching with a level of detail that makes us think of a real-world video, while it is a virtual representation of clothing for MetaHumans 5.6 because LEGEND BATTLES runs under Nanite 5.6, a technology that enables the display of highly detailed assets without performance bottlenecks. It achieves this by using a virtualized geometry system that automatically handles levels of detail (LODs) and compresses meshes.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/859fe29522bcd502a6278eb69bd0204ecdf632f5.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Lumen 5.6 dynamic lighting:[/p][p]Clothing glows in thousands of colors just like in real life because LEGEND BATTLES offers Lumen 5.6, a real-time global lighting and reflection system that produces highly detailed lighting and reflections on clothing. Lumen 5.6 dynamically manages diffuse and specular reflections, including those from emissive surfaces and multiple reflections between surfaces. Lumen 5.6 utilizes a hybrid ray tracing pipeline, combining software and hardware ray tracing methods for optimal performance and visual quality.[/p][p] [/p][p]Chaos 5.6 physical simulation:[/p][p]Chaos Cloth 5.6 enables cloth-to-cloth constraints with more realistic interactions between different garments and makes interchangeable garments even more realistic. Chaos Cloth 5.6 morph targets enables more complex and dynamic garment simulations. Finally, improved dataflow nodes accelerate the performance and fluidity of garment simulations.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/19db41b8f0dc1034ee80655751b2c3d13077accf.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]2. Camouflage and Stealth[/p][p]With millions of clothing combinations, LEGEND BATTLES no longer limits your choices, so the hardest part is knowing how you want to dress and show yourself to develop your identity and personality.[/p][p]. In urban zones, darker or grey tones help you blend into shadows or industrial textures.[/p][p]. In deserts or rocky areas, beige and brown clothing gives you a stealth edge.[/p][p]. In forests or green zones, use camo or foliage-patterned outfits.[/p][p]. In snowy environments, the white blends you into the landscape.[/p][p]. Bright colors or flashy patterns attract attention and turn you into a celebrity during the gaming session if you are a high-ranking shooter.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/10488fdeaeca8a166dcea6c8ecf9b4e07070cbdc.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]3. Silhouette, movement and animation disruptions[/p][p]Clothes are powerful artifacts to hide one's figure and to hide one's movements.[/p][p]. Some clothing designs break up your outline, making you harder to spot at a distance.[/p][p]. Baggy clothing can sometimes confuse enemy aim, especially in quick movement.[/p][p]. Tight-fitting clothes makes movement easier to track and reveal posture changes.[/p][p]. Layered or flowing clothing obscure animations and offer psychological advantages.[/p][p]For players wearing "Sci-fi armor", the enemy will assume that they are carrying heavy weapons but in fact, they may be holding daggers.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/6a2cf180fa3ab0b52f97a110d41f53451578cbe0.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]4. Tactical Readability[/p][p]Outfits often signal your role or playstyle:[/p][p]. Heavily armored gear = aggressive or frontline.[/p][p]. Light scout gear = flanking or reconnaissance.[/p][p]. Elegant/rare outfits = experienced or daring player.[/p][p]This can influence how enemies perceive and engage you.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/a98b90f8a144300eb2f09968d3250d4bd5defc22.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]5. Customization for Team Play[/p][p]In squad modes, coordinate clothing with your team:[/p][p]. Similar patterns/colors help identify allies quickly.[/p][p]. You can also intentionally diversify to confuse enemies in chaotic firefights.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/1ba8db75a214b241e9a3c8d55a9a6d9a448991c8.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]6. Immersion & Identity[/p][p]Especially in a game like Legend Battles, with Metahumans and millions of clothing combos, clothing becomes an expression of player identity and even status.[/p][p]Unlocking legendary or rare skins show you’ve survived and earned your way through high-tier challenges.[/p][p]The ultimate, of course, remains the clothing obtained after a victory during a game session and purchased using the rewards from the energy capsules collected.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/c7c66dd86afeaacd5a27b41ef41c7b8e77daf943.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]7. Clothing economic system with STEAM Community Market[/p][p]Buying different Season Passes and selling some of those skins separately on the STEAM Community Market should help you recoup the cost of your different Season Passes. This is a smart way to get free skins and maybe even treat yourself to a coffee with the profits, thanks to LEGEND BATTLES's connection to the STEAM Community Market.[/p][p]So you can stock up on holiday themes such as Halloween pumpkin heads and sell them off-season the following year. Manage scarcity to raise your prices in the STEAM community market. Be a savvy businessman.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/e5323e4648030e6567a3fd4e987f09eba877b6ea.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]8. Summary: Clothing is the "second weapon"[/p][p]The clothing system of LEGEND BATTLES uses technologies like Nanite, Lumen, Chaos Cloth from Unreal Engine 5.6 with such a huge variety of interchangeable clothing, there are no limits to your imagination.[/p][p] [/p][p]Functionality: affecting movement, concealment, and psychological gameplay.[/p][p]Artistry: UE5.6 makes virtual fashion comparable to high-end fashion shows.[/p][p]Funding: Steam Community Marketplace gives birth to "virtual clothing merchants".[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/1b2c71d13663f58f8bb11bed822581016b05d810.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]So, dear braves, come join our ranks, participate in the tough test battles during future Playtest sessions and follow us now on STEAM to loudly and clearly affirm your support for our fight.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you on LEGEND BATTLES, Braves.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Official website: [url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Thousands of hyper-realistic weapons
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Braves,
[/p][p]Like in any compelling shooter game, LEGEND BATTLES’ weapons are the primary tools through which players interact with the world and engage in combat. Beyond just their visual models, several key points define LEGEND BATTLES’ weapon's effectiveness, feel, and strategic role. These aspects collectively contribute to the "gunplay" and the overall player experience. All of this was made possible by Unreal Engine 5.6 with the Chaos, Lumen, Nanite, and MetaSounds 5.6 systems, as well as the advanced weapon technologies of LEGEND BATTLES.[/p][p] [/p][p]Here is the video to let you understand the key points of weapons in LEGEND BATTLES game:[/p][previewyoutube="yqvgHGxTdZQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p]1. Weapon Types & Categories[/p][p]· Primary Weapons: These include assault rifles, sniper rifles, shotguns, and SMGs. They form the core of your loadout and determine your combat style.[/p][p]· Secondary Weapons: Items like pistols, revolvers, and melee weapons. Secondary weapons offer versatility for close combats or act as backup when your primary weapon is out of ammo.[/p][p]· Heavy weapons: Items like RPGs, grenade launchers, miniguns, flamethrowers. These weapons have a huge striking force to destroy a helicopter in mid-flight or an armored vehicle at high speed because the game always remains balanced in LEGEND BATTLES.[/p][p]· Special Weapons: These are grenades, Molotov cocktails, C-4 remote-controlled explosives. Special weapons provide additional tactical options like area denial or crowd control.[/p][p]· Melee Weapons: Close-range weapons like tactical knives and guitars. Melee weapons are a stealthy kill option or an emergency weapon.[/p][p]LEGEND BATTLES features the full range of ground weapons with a weapon diversity that exceeds all the best dreams of a well-balanced Battle Royale where only agility, intelligence and skill will reward the victors.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/8b9439f19d698d4cdb20d2b2bb3e924071e2480e.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]2. Weapon Characteristics[/p][p]· Fire Rate: How fast the weapon shoots. High fire rates are great for close combat, while low fire rates are ideal for long-range accuracy.[/p][p]o Ultra-High Fire Rate: Miniguns.[/p][p]o High Fire Rate: SMGs, Assault Rifles (for rapid suppression).[/p][p]o Low Fire Rate: Sniper Rifles, Shotguns (for accuracy and power).[/p][p]· Reload Speed: How quickly a weapon can be reloaded is a key point of differentiation in LEGEND BATTLES combat. Faster reloads are beneficial in close-quarters combat, while slower reloads might require better positioning.[/p][p]· Range: Some weapons excel at close range, such as pistols, while others are better at long range, such as taking down a helicopter with a grenade launcher or sniper rifle.[/p][p]o Close Range: Pistols, Revolvers, Shotguns, SMGs (ideal for tight spaces).[/p][p]o Long Range: RPG, Snipers, Rifles (ideal for picking off distant targets).[/p][p]· Accuracy: The precision of the weapon at various ranges. Accuracy is influenced by:[/p][p]o Sway (movement while aiming).[/p][p]o Recoil (how much the weapon kicks when fired).[/p][p]o Stability (ability to control recoil).[/p][p]With Unreal Engine 5.6's Chaos, Lumen, Nanite, and MetaSounds 5.6 systems, along with LEGEND BATTLES' advanced weapon technologies, weapons are more hyper-realistic than ever in this Battle Royale game app.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/01af0f5225f23591eb5984857b0d37c1b3b0da60.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]3. Ammo Capacity & Reloading[/p][p]· Clip Size: A larger magazine allows sustained fire, reducing the need for frequent reloading. Smaller magazines usually offer greater mobility or faster reload.[/p][p]· Ammo Count: How many bullets you can carry. Managing ammo in extended fights is crucial—when ammo runs low, players have to scavenge or conserve shots.[/p][p]There is no universal tactic in LEGEND BATTLES and each game session will allow you to develop different strategies to be the last surviving team in the end.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/41abaaaf9897c574d650eeadb3533ca4e9ce0175.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]4. Recoil & Handling[/p][p]· Recoil Patterns: Recoil influences the accuracy after each shot. Weapons with high recoil may require players to burst fire or compensate for movement.[/p][p]· Handling: How easily a weapon can be aimed and fired. Some weapons are heavier, affecting your movement speed, while others are more maneuverable.[/p][p]Strategic Play: Players often use controlled bursts or hip-fire when handling high-recoil weapons, while snipers take more careful shots with high-recoil.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ee359d0e13231d31df4a0bbc3512c91c08dd0b6c.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]5. Weapon Attachments[/p][p]· Scopes & Sights: These influence the zoom or field of view (FOV). Long-range scopes are ideal for snipers, while red dots or holographic sights provide faster target acquisition at close-range.[/p][p]· Barrels & Muzzles: Attachments like silencers (for stealth) and compensators (for recoil control) significantly alter how weapons perform.[/p][p]· Stocks & Grips: Aiming stability and recoil management are enhanced with attachments like grips and stocks.[/p][p]· Extended Magazines: Provide more ammunition without the need to reload constantly.[/p][p]Don't miss out when you can loot them, as they'll greatly improve your weapon's performance. Be careful, though: attachments aren't universal, and each one is tailored to specific weapon types in LEGEND BATTLES.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/f8d1f010ae11e6e836558ead72402e8059aa54f6.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]6. Reload Mechanics[/p][p]· Reload Time: Affects the flow of combat. Fast reloads allow quicker engagement but can be risky in close fights if you're not mindful.[/p][p]· Tactical Reload vs. Speed Reload: LEGEND BATTLES offers the option of choosing between reloading a few bullets for faster re-engagement or performing a full reload.[/p][p]Reactivity is a fundamental key element for one's own survival in LEGEND BATTLES, and therefore it is important to optimize each action taken during combat with a particular strategy based on the tactics developed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/6d2a9aadbb4a0ea72f34baf628802abf07c9558c.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]7. Weapon Weight and Mobility[/p][p]· Heavy Weapons: Miniguns, LMGs, Sniper Rifles, etc., tend to slow down movement, making players more vulnerable to faster enemies.[/p][p]· Light Weapons: Pistols, SMGs, and shotguns often provide greater mobility, allowing players to run faster and more agile.[/p][p]A team of four players should have a much better chance of winning than a single player, as LEGEND BATTLES was designed from the ground up to be balanced. Also, the four players should share different weapon characteristics to be more effective in combat, such as grenade launcher, minigun, LMG, flamethrower and sniper rifle as their secondary weapon, SMG, shotgun as their primary weapon, and pistol or revolver as their third weapon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/eb7a4e1d885b915a36bf5b076717f1dd12e37765.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]8. Weapon Sound[/p][p]· Audio Cues: Some weapons, especially snipers or shotguns, create distinctive sound signatures, which could reveal your position.[/p][p]· Silencers: Allow for stealth gameplay, making it harder for enemies to detect your location.[/p][p]MetaSounds 5.6 in Legend Battles is more than just about audio fidelity—it’s about tactical advantage and immersive realism. The weapon sounds, coupled with dynamic audio feedback, make combat interactions feel more real and intense. Players will rely on sound cues not just for immersion, but to outsmart enemies, track positions, and respond to threats. In the world of fast-paced battle royale like Legend Battles, these sound elements can make the difference between victory and defeat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/4d313f260ed1c2e0c728aec941c9ae3f19a55fa4.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]9. Weapon Tiers & Rarity[/p][p]· Weapon Rarity: Weapons come in different rarities, affecting their damage, durability, or special properties.[/p][p]· Upgrades: High-tier weapons often have better stats and more customization options. These are typically harder to find but highly coveted.[/p][p]Given "LEGEND BATTLES'" ambition for "hyper-realism" and its player-friendly monetization, the weapon tier/rarity system makes sense for providing loot progression and excitement. It will amplify the thrill of exploration and risk-taking: Players will be more inclined to push into dangerous areas or contest supply drops if the reward is a significantly better weapon. And the emphasis on "more customization options" for higher-tier weapons is a very good design choice in LEGEND BATTLES. This means the upgrade isn't just raw stats, but also increased utility and personalization, which aligns well with the game's strong customization focus.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/1f27902f5f257b353b9d6e7abf579d68b5603c8c.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]10. Impact and Damage[/p][p]· Damage Per Shot: Weapons differ in how much damage they deal per bullet. Sniper rifles and shotguns, for example, deal significant damage, but their fire rate is slower.[/p][p]· Headshot vs. Body Damage: Headshots typically deal critical damage, especially with sniper rifles and high-caliber weapons.[/p][p]· Engine Shot vs. Window Damage: Engine shots generally inflict critical damage, especially with miniguns and grenade launchers, which cause the vehicle to explode later.[/p][p]· Bullet Drop: Some long-range weapons experience bullet drop, requiring players to aim higher or lead their shots over longer distances.[/p][p]In LEGEND BATTLES, health and injury levels are as essential for metahumans as maintenance and fuel levels are for vehicles. Metahuman and vehicle performance are heavily impacted by these levels, which are best maintained or topped up.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/889a91eb9816a5bd826cfd1eed0b8dffe5b47acb.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]11. Medical kit[/p][p]The medical kit system in LEGEND BATTLES, including items like energy drinks, pain pills, bandages, morphine injections, cardiovascular injectors, and assistance, to provide strategic depth to the game’s combat and survival mechanics like:[/p][p]· Energy Drinks to boost stamina or movement speed temporarily.[/p][p]· Pain Pills to provide a temporary health boost or accelerate health recovery.[/p][p]· Bandages for a small amount of health.[/p][p]· Morphine Injections to reduce pain and speed up recovery.[/p][p]· Cardiovascular Injectors to boost your heart rate, health increasing stamina.[/p][p]· Assistance for team revival If you’re playing in squads to revive downed teammates.[/p][p]These medical items add a significant layer of strategy to [i]Legend Battles[/i]. Beyond just fighting enemies, you must think about when to heal, which items to use, and how to manage resources. The choice between using a bandage for quick healing, taking a morphine injection to stay in the fight, or using a cardiovascular injector to maintain stamina and health during long battles will greatly impact how you approach combat.[/p][p]Since you enjoy strategic gameplay in [i]Legend Battles[/i], managing your medical supplies and choosing the right healing item for the right moment will definitely give you an edge over your opponents.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/7f8242f6370c433d67bd6761065b040364412e27.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]12. Energy capsules as Collectibles[/p][p]Energy capsules refer to the "five elements" which are Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water. These red, yellow, silver, blue and green energy capsules are collectible items, scattered throughout the game world. These Energy capsules are not used for immediate benefits but can be accumulated and later exchanged for rewards if the team wins the game session.[/p][p] [/p][p]During the five stages in which the battle circle tightens, the five types of energy capsules are scattered across the battlefield in varying numbers:[/p][p]. 9 red energy capsules during the first reduction of the restricted battle zone.[/p][p]. 7 yellow energy capsules during the second reduction of the restricted battle zone.[/p][p]. 5 silver energy capsules during the third reduction of the restricted battle zone.[/p][p]. 3 blue energy capsules during the fourth reduction of the restricted battle zone.[/p][p]. 1 green energy capsule during the last reduction of the restricted battle zone.[/p][p]The team must bring back 1 energy capsule of each of the 5 types and also win the game session to win the jackpot of points and Battle Coins. This is a very high-level challenge that only heroes can conquer![/p][p] [/p][p]Energy Capsules are an indicator of rarity and value; they allow players to purchase more exclusive items, such as legendary gear or epic weapons. They offer special rewards for achievements and milestones, a status symbol in LEGEND BATTLES for the battle session winners.[/p][p] [/p][p]Indeed, Energy Capsules enable an in-game economy where heroes can purchase or earn content, making it accessible to LEGEND BATTLES players. They are essential to strategy, progression, and game balance, providing strategic advantages and the opportunity to obtain limited-edition clothing, weapons, and vehicles, sold at premium prices on the STEAM Community Market.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/6cc2c444763a87e5df19f1750b98a629dea8d635.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Strategic Breakdown:[/p][p]Close-Quarter Combat:[/p][p]· Shotguns, SMGs, and pistols are ideal.[/p][p]· Speed and maneuverability matter more than long-range accuracy.[/p][p]Mid-Range Combat:[/p][p]· Assault rifles, LMGs, and burst weapons offer a balance of speed and power.[/p][p]· Focus on recoil control and weapon stability.[/p][p]Long-Range Combat:[/p][p]· Sniper rifles and DMRs (Designated Marksman Rifles) for picking off enemies from a distance.[/p][p]· You’ll need to account for bullet drop and wind, requiring precision and patience.[/p][p] [/p][p]Key Considerations for Weapon Choice:[/p][p]· Mobility: Heavier weapons slow you down, making them less ideal for fast-paced combat or quick positioning.[/p][p]· Combat Range: Match your weapon to the environment. Tight urban maps favor shotguns and SMGs, while open fields may require snipers or LMGs.[/p][p]· Tactical Team Play: Consider supporting teammates with recoil-reducing weapons, or silencers for stealth approaches.[/p][p] [/p][p]Synthesis:[/p][p]Weapon selection in LEGEND BATTLES is all about balance—damage vs. speed, mobility vs. power, and long-range vs. close-range. The choice of weapon significantly impacts your playstyle and strategy. Adapting to each scenario and understanding weapon strengths can give you a strategic edge over your opponents and as usual, there is no miracle recipe in LEGEND BATTLES, and everything depends on the strategy and tactics selected according to the agility and mobility of the terrain.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]So, dear braves, come join our ranks, participate in the tough test battles during future Playtest sessions and follow us now on STEAM to loudly and clearly affirm your support for our fight.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you on LEGEND BATTLES, Braves.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] [/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Official website:[url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Thousands of Hyper-realistic vehicles
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Braves,
[/p][p]You'll be able to collect all these vehicles on the different battlefields. There are no specific rules for obtaining a particular vehicle, such as an armored vehicle, a racing car, a racing motorcycle, or even better, a helicopter. Get lucky or persist, then you will achieve your dream in LEGEND BATTLES![/p][previewyoutube="0Hyc5LPAYNU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In fact, all vehicles have been designed in LEGEND BATTLES to offer balanced advantages and disadvantages to ensure fair combats. On foot, equipped with an RPG, the armored vehicle won't last long, or rather, will be left in a blaze of flames after exploding.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/252d381038c44121d15f7187175d48f41f1c65f8.gif"][/img][/p][p]You can drive the vehicles in first-person and third-person perspectives. Driving is completely different in these two modes and requires different levels of expertise. Furthermore, each vehicle presents its own unique challenges, and there is no universal driving style that can be applied to all vehicles, as you won't drive an armored vehicle, an all-terrain vehicle, a buggy, a dirt bike, or even a helicopter in the same way. Survival requires a range of skills that are the prerogative of heroes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/1314e6f917cf465a7b24b7c8e1dcb9a871beb1c7.gif"][/img][/p][p]Vehicles are fabulous means of transportation with very different characteristics. They can accommodate a pilot and a co-pilot, while larger vehicles can accommodate two passengers. Motorcycles can accommodate a driver and a passenger, and helicopters have seats for a pilot, a co-pilot, and four passengers. Of course, jet-powered flight suits are single-seaters.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/8c6276a4bcd8570ebbbf2ab7b25ab8f3b3f4aafb.gif"][/img][/p][p]Traveling in a vehicle is often a safari where moving targets are your enemies. All passengers can fire in all directions but be careful not to kill your teammates in the rush. The most impressive firing positions are those located in helicopters, motorcycles, and off-road 4x4s, but in reality, each vehicle offers its own firing positions, and you must quickly learn to master them to ensure your survival in LEGEND BATTLES.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/95dabf6c9353cb72c6bfad35649f257399bcd56d.gif"][/img][/p][p]Vehicles are a bit like players; they have a health level to maintain and must be replenished with fuel cans. Also, keep an eye on the fuel gauge, as you risk continuing on foot under enemy fire, as well as the animated vehicle maintenance bar. And if your vehicle's maintenance bar is at 100%, you will then be able to drive at full speed on all terrains, provided you know how to maneuver your vehicle well.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/e70881cc32e73509b20c899230fbc46c30094ba9.gif"][/img][/p][p]The vehicles were developed with the most advanced technologies, resulting in an astonishing level of realism. First, the Chaos 5.6 system animates the vehicles with realistic physics. Second, the Lumen 5.6 system illuminates the interiors and exteriors of vehicles with multiple reflections, very close to natural light in a dynamic global illumination. Finally, the Nanite 5.6 system allows for exceptional definition of all vehicle details without limitations, like photogrammetry.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/6f8eef527cb7fbe2858c92ceec7ed90f638b41bf.gif"][/img][/p][p]All vehicles are partially destructible under impact or enemy fire, so say goodbye to your doors, hood, trunk, windows, windshield, bumpers, and tires. Worse still, the engine and fuel tank are the most vulnerable parts, which can quickly catch fire under enemy fire, causing the vehicle to explode, with fatal consequences for those left behind.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/1be87ca3ca158a44aa32b336281a2acd8d194735.gif"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to Unreal Engine 5.6's Chaos system, our race cars can reach 406 km/h (252 mph) and our race bikes 395 km/h (245 mph). These speeds are incredible, but they're made possible by the extreme stability of LEGEND BATTLES' vehicle system. Additionally, the terrain has been modeled using technologies from the continent of Bellona to allow vehicles to move with ease and stability, while still providing stunning realism.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/4f0e052c09d348408408ab3b237e2b056810848c.gif"][/img][/p][p]Armored vehicles are bound to be very attractive machines, especially with the wonderful skins they come in. They can go just about anywhere, just like an off-road 4x4, and with the power of a buffalo to clear everything in their path. Since the windows are smaller, their passengers are better protected, which is their advantage, but also their disadvantage: it's much harder to shoot through the window of an armored vehicle. Moreover, armored vehicles are destructible under fire from grenade launchers, multiple grenades, multiple Molotov cocktails, miniguns, and many other weapons. Combat in LEGEND BATTLES has been designed to be balanced regardless of the weapons and vehicles you choose. The best way to survive is to be agile, skillful and smart.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/8ceffe9f5ef068b740ca62a65f73d3f816cb3b16.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Helicopters are fantastic machines that quickly overcome the dense infrastructure of megacities. But of course, they are not invincible, as many weapons such as RPGs, grenade launchers, miniguns, and flamethrowers can bring down a helicopter, especially if the shooter is positioned on the roof of a skyscraper. When the helicopter starts to catch fire, whether the turbine or fuel tank has been hit, you must quickly parachute out of the helicopter. Of course, the enemies who brought down your helicopter are waiting for you and will not hesitate to shoot you while you are parachuting, especially snipers. Surviving is the legend battles![/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]So, dear braves, come join our ranks, participate in the tough test battles during future Playtest sessions and follow us now on STEAM to loudly and clearly affirm your support for our fight.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you on LEGEND BATTLES, Braves.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Official website:[url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Bellona DLC: 400 km2, hundreds of megacities, interiors in all buildings
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Braves,
[/p][p]The free Bellona DLC map is the 400 km² continental world of LEGEND BATTLES, which is connected to the 25 km² western island of Aurora by several bridges, and this Aurora island is included with the app. The Bellona DLC is simply gigantic, with specifications never before achieved for a Battle Royale game app.[/p][previewyoutube="nDKuPF7X49M;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Bellona is 400 km² of rocky mountainous deserts, dotted with hundreds of mega-cities with very different architectural styles for each megalopolis, an extreme density of urban infrastructure with thousands of accessible buildings with varied and richly furnished interiors, accessible rooftops well equipped for combat, and some infrastructures with rather cyberpunk-style basements and cellars. The spaceships in the sky are accessible by zip lines for combat on these immense machines and also for the most experienced snipers.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/760dfeda6f2f333102233ec08248252491531d85.png"][/img][/p][p]Let's take about ten examples from among the hundreds of megacities, because it is impossible for us to describe each of these numerous battlefields.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/89a4fdb479e51df543965aea61b2b7c6a34f8a4a.png"][/img][/p][p]Gigantic hangars house enormous spaceships for their maintenance and these hangars are nested one after the other to carry out the various maintenance operations of these intergalactic spaceships. These hangars are full of all kinds of equipment, scattered everywhere, and they become real hiding places to organize fatal ambushes so great caution is required to move in all these hangars.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/c6699f1c396c31f1fcec02c3212117b9b52afece.png"][/img][/p][p]The cyberpunk sewers are very present in LEGEND BATTLES and constitute veritable labyrinths in which it is easy to get lost and never leave. Moreover, with their gloomy lights, the fights are difficult and only the best will come out alive. In addition, these sewers are populated by strange noises that come mainly from the large ventilation systems. Remember that you can climb everywhere, so your salvation will depend in part on your agility to move skillfully.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ac3767635b549bdabfe8d65eb54a97cf2ec88e87.png"][/img][/p][p]There are many science fiction space bases in Bellona and they all have very different styles with dense infrastructures and interiors with well-stocked computer furniture, so it will not be possible for you to cross a space base in one go in a few moments. Passing through a space base is often laborious and only allows passage on a motorcycle because cars require a wheelbase that is not always appropriate in a space base where a multitude of equipment litters the ground.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/4fc49f381d054f13e4191e151b9e896839b94f12.png"][/img][/p][p]This sci-fi city is crisscrossed by numerous underground levels that quickly become cutthroat as the gunfire from all levels is difficult to predict. Many vehicles circulate in the air as this city is the commercial hub of Bellona and it is an ideal place to do business provided you are well equipped with submachine guns, which are often a strong selling point. And since traffic is easy, as in most of the megacities in LEGEND BATTLES, then racing cars might well be a preferable choice for racing drivers to escape the enemy fires.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/13dbcce310fe5df1544b15edd08d1c55015f546e.png"][/img][/p][p]Well, here is a vast futuristic city built in the middle of the desert that must house workers given the functional side of its urban infrastructure. All floors of the buildings in this city are habitable with richly furnished interiors in a very futuristic style. Also, danger can come from each floor and if you hear a window breaking then imagine that a bullet is heading towards you if it is not too late. Thus each battlefield requires its own strategy and forget the all-purpose strategies that become mediocre on the battlefields of LEGEND BATTLES. To survive, be agile, skillful and intelligent with plenty of resources and victory will be at your fingertips.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/c1a6f536625e5ee1b7fdcdef3dd31df451ebd5cf.png"][/img][/p][p]Bellona is populated by numerous Egyptian, Greek, Roman, Incan, and extraterrestrial temples, not to mention industrial sites, industrial ports, racetracks, and many other things that you'll be surprised to discover in LEGEND BATTLES. The temples are full of hiding places and nooks and crannies that quickly become ambush sites. To complicate matters, zip lines are present in many locations, and since players can climb anywhere, danger quickly becomes a habit. But in all this, you have time to marvel at the magnificence of these temples, of remarkable beauty, and don't hold back from fabulous selfies to share your happiness with your friends.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/456f05d9fd533de872e6594e1834feef0eca70d9.png"][/img][/p][p]You will be faced with exploring the infrastructure of Arab, Hindu, Western, cyberpunk, and futuristic megacities that offer no common ground. Also, if your combat strategy has been to learn the battlefield by heart, LEGEND BATTLES will pose new challenges that you will have to quickly overcome to survive in these worlds built primarily for hyper-realistic Battle Royale combat. Running on Unreal Engine 5.6, LEGEND BATTLES offers a multitude of details, lights, and special effects that immerse players in an ultra-realistic world, and this is one of the fundamental differences in LEGEND BATTLES, with, of course, the 400 km2 of Bellona, which is unprecedented.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/a4ceb9cce8ac441e7e04d6f86a6f33c4c34f0e2e.png"][/img][/p][p]Sci-fi corridors are commonplace in the interiors and basements of Bellona and Aurora. They're all different too, making them difficult to navigate with practice. However, you have to get used to adapting to constantly changing environments, just as special forces do in reality, in order to return safely after combat. These corridors are equipped with very different lighting, and their complexities can quickly turn into a labyrinth for the less experienced. These corridors are sometimes dotted with protective equipment, but occasionally, some alleys are completely devoid of them, and the danger becomes palpable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/7b94de2c35bbabaa67b570eb702e6b5016a59b18.png"][/img][/p][p]We have seen megacities with different underground floors and here is one of the megacities with different exterior levels including elevated roads. From a high road, shooters will certainly be waiting for you if you go lower and it could be fatal because when you do not expect it, well, you are not on your guard. And this is one of the difficulties of LEGEND BATTLES because, just like in reality, danger comes from everywhere because the enemies have taken care to position themselves in places that we do not imagine and therefore you will not essentially be on our guard.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/df0dc00ea272d5320e6391810e81bc503e1fba74.png"][/img][/p][p]Sci-fi industrial sites are terrifying because you never know where danger is coming from. These industrial sites feature glass interiors, walkways that allow you to quickly move from one building to another, and their industrial equipment provides ideal protection for shooting your enemies. Their infrastructure and industrial processes are all very different. Knowing one of them will not protect you from the others, as they have nothing in common. Stay alert, agile, mobile, and quickly develop formidable strategies that will surely lead you to ultimate victory.[/p][p] [/p][p]So, dear braves, come join our ranks, participate in the tough test battles during future Playtest sessions and follow us now on STEAM to loudly and clearly affirm your support for our fight.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you on LEGEND BATTLES, Braves.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Official website: [url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p]

[/p][p][/p][p][b]Jean-Pierre RAFFARIN, Former French Prime Minister, Partner of this game, supports and admires LEGEND BATTLES:[/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="4rMoGnW4Xsg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Hello everyone, ladies and gentlemen,[/p][p] [/p][p]I am very pleased today to participate in what is a major event, that's to say, the launch of LEGEND BATTLES. notes.title: Sci-fi battleground discoveries, Part 3
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Braves,
[/p][p]This video is part of a first series of three journeys through the wonders of our battlefields, which range from science fiction, cyberpunk, and modern and luxurious architecture. Battlefields display a profound beauty that inspires the wonder of an exceptional virtual life and this is the video #3.[/p][previewyoutube="lZd8U377XaA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We're opening the LEGEND BATTLES download in the STEAM Playtest program with a 110 GB app to offer privileged access to players registered in the Playtest. These players will then discover the island of Rhodes, located to the west of this vast 400 km2 world, the incredible selection of avatars and clothing of all kinds, the immense array of weapons adorned with fantastic skins, and the wide range of vehicles customized with wonderful skins.[/p][p] [/p][p]The playtest is a kind of training center in the location that suits you best because you can freely walk around all the battlefields at your leisure.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ea10ee1bacf9b1b94e5ed8ca813b76c69c1699fc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Let's visit some locations in the worlds of LEGEND BATTLES.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/817432d0cf3d09ff35f395c360a63646c102ba4d.png"][/img][/p][p]The alien forests are all completely different in terms of vegetation and topology, which greatly enriches the map and provides immense pleasure in constantly discovering new wonderful places. These forests are built next to a sci-fi village and are dotted with menacing cyberpunk buildings. The ponds, common in these forests, are an excellent camouflage to surprise and eliminate your opponents, as the avatars are excellent swimmers. They can swim underwater or on the surface depending on the situation. But of course, swimming underwater can only be short-lived, under penalty of death. Also, the avatars' locomotion system is very extensive and offers all the possible movements found in shooter games.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/6dae2cb1a5ffbc6003d7f533d8d43e69691c91ac.png"][/img][/p][p]It's always impressive to find yourself behind the wheel of a vehicle in third-person, and this sensation is even stronger in first-person. Seeing the landscape pass by at full speed provides a thrill, while at slower speeds, players can marvel at the beauty of the landscapes, whether sci-fi, cyberpunk, or even luxurious and modern. It's clear that the level of detail is identical to reality, as the implemented technologies based on Unreal Engine 5.6 required a colossal amount of work to achieve such a result.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/9b64312e177d1e4473188f998c9484dd1ef11ead.png"][/img][/p][p]A first-person view of this majestic cathedral reveals the splendor of its interiors, with an incredible level of detail. The cartographic innovations are undoubtedly a major asset of LEGEND BATTLES, while the various elements of the game are just as full of innovations, perhaps less striking than the immensity of the map. The weapons are indeed very realistic, and this submachine gun is a real goldsmith's work whose finish is of great finesse, even a work of art.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/79f20ac8ba043d2d542263822909e4adc6eaa752.png"][/img][/p][p]What a beautiful harmony of colors in a marvelous landscape that takes shape at the speed of this magnificent customized motorcycle. Not to mention the clothing of this avatar, with its delightful colors and impeccable finishes. All this resembles more the symphony of a wonderful world that nevertheless welcomes fighters, because these fights are mainly organized for fun. Military outfits are certainly present, but they are not the rigorous outfits of LEGEND BATTLES. This game is above all a great fun among friends to welcome all cultures, beliefs and ambitions because the more the merrier![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/27642674dc7438d313cb85344e5d91157cd9c5a5.png"][/img][/p][p]The vehicles are equipped with 5- or 6-speed automatic transmissions, depending on the model. This allows them to reach impressive speeds and clearly hear the gear changes. In addition, the vehicle's dashboard clearly displays the speed and gear currently in use. In addition, the vehicles are equipped with a fuel gauge, which should be kept in mind: when it reaches its lowest level, you will need to refuel with a jerrycan recovered from the ground and carefully placed in your backpack or continue on foot.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ddbe2175f442ded9a6efe4af22aad53785519fa5.png"][/img][/p][p]This aerospace base is a vast combat zone where military vehicles, combat helicopters, and spaceships rub shoulders. Ammunition and fuel depots are scattered throughout the base in a climate of security. The maintenance hangars are overflowing with equipment and fighter jets, making it a real cutthroat place for anyone who dares to venture there.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/9e640fee9e9c8cce011a07fc24d7466e1026e62b.png"][/img][/p][p]These buildings constitute a vast high security prison under the control of a military base with mess halls, visiting rooms, fenced open-air yards, a multitude of prisons on different floors and even maximum security science fiction cells for the most brutal prisoners, not to mention the underground prisons where life must be terrible. Also, players who wander through these prisons get a taste of the terrible prison life and the combat is magnificent because it is a game first and foremost.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/4c7cf3aedb15312046a2feab63d0af06cf0ca501.png"][/img][/p][p]The hover train's station city is brimming with shops of all kinds, and the infrastructure of this futuristic station allows for dizzying ascents to incredible heights. Every detail of this megalopolis is impressive and offers a wonderfully realistic experience for players passing through. And because this city is built along its length, vehicles can reach impressive speeds for even more fun.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/301da96dfe82dd75438126ba8ee493d049539606.png"][/img][/p][p]The zip lines leading to the spaceships positioned in the sky are a real attraction. These ships are gigantic, sometimes larger than a football field, so be careful when you arrive, as enemies may be waiting for you. At the top, the view is breathtaking, and the height still allows expert snipers to hit their targets. From there, you can reach most rooftops by parachute, as it's also a good strategy to position yourself in new locations to better surprise your opponents.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/8526ef5011edee611802e29ca7043f83e36f037f.png"][/img][/p][p]When players arrive on the battlefield, the flying suit jump from the spaceship is always an exhilarating moment that requires quick decision-making regarding the strategy to choose the right landing spot for the entire team. And from up there, what a marvel to admire this futuristic football stadium surrounded by a majestic lake and these modern sculptures! All this may captivate your attention, but you must remain focused on the objective assigned to the entire team, which will reach the ground in a few seconds.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ae4a6c71d26f5e20898645dc7fc835756d992464.png"][/img][/p][p]Taking a zip line to soar a long distance from a towering skyscraper is a surprising adventure. From up there, you can calculate your best landing point, which isn't necessarily the zip line destination where snipers await you. At such a height, the best option is obviously to jump along the way to land on the roof of a building where no enemies await you. In the meantime, take full advantage of the view because at such a height, you're out of range of any weapon. And throughout these images, you may have noticed a very wide range of interchangeagle clothing, which is just a small sample of the vast wardrobe that awaits every player.[/p][p]
You can drive racing cars and racing motorcycles at full speed without any restrictions, allowing yourself to be exhilarated by the speed, as these vehicles can reach speeds of 400 km/h.

All weapons are at your disposal; you just need to pick them up to reload and shoot. Some weapons are frankly dangerous and must be handled with great care, such as C-4 explosives, Molotov cocktails, and flamethrowers.

Take advantage of the playtest to dress your avatar in all the outfits that appeal to you in order to prepare for your future purchases. And there's nothing better than training in fancy outfits to show off in your fantastic selfies, armed with impressive gear alongside the most beautiful cars or even from the top of a helicopter.

In fact, the playtest is a unique opportunity for you to train and make videos for your social media at leisure, without the stress of combat. And if you enjoy this, then we will add a feature for you to walk freely in the LEGEND BATTLES battlefields with your friends in peacetime.[/p][p] [/p][p]So, dear braves, come join our ranks, participate in the tough test battles during future Playtest sessions and follow us now on STEAM to loudly and clearly affirm your support for our fight.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you on LEGEND BATTLES, Braves.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Official website: [url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Sci-fi battleground discoveries, Part 2
notes.notes: [p]Greetings Braves,[/p][p] [/p][p]Discover wondrous battlefields, dense urban architecture, sci-fi interiors, well-equipped rooftops, cyberpunk basements with the Sci-fi battleground discoveries, video Part 2[/p][previewyoutube="SPqW61dITJw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]I want to let you know that we're opening the LEGEND BATTLES download in the STEAM Playtest program with a 98 GB app to offer privileged access to players registered in the Playtest. These players will then discover the island of Rhodes, located to the west of this vast 400 km2 world, the incredible selection of avatars and clothing of all kinds, the immense array of weapons adorned with fantastic skins, and the wide range of vehicles customized with wonderful skins.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/01398a13de5c00d02b85a253766ee99003479226.png"][/img][/p][p]Let's visit some locations in the worlds of LEGEND BATTLES.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/6d21efc18988175899f244cdd1bfe714f435fa51.png"][/img][/p][p]In LEGEND BATTLES, there are even trenches of sorts in the aerial basements of this vast sci-fi city. Since players can climb everything, they can easily enter these trenches and exit as soon as enemies appear.[/p][p]The mini map is absolutely essential for navigating these unknown battlegrounds, finding teammates, and building a combat strategy in these uncharted lands.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/0f608aca2a2d52e1e1805012a1431980aa48fe9a.png"][/img][/p][p]Armed with a submachine gun, this player step onto a bridge in the heart of a science-fiction world populated by a thousand and one nooks and crannies. They can play alone, with two players, in a trio, or in a squad. They can also play in third-person or first-person, depending on the situation. LEGEND BATTLES frees players from many constraints, allowing them to play in a space of freedom.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/3e56fbb06073605f7f78cb9b1d4e06c52dae7fa3.png"][/img][/p][p]LEGEND BATTLES offers a multitude of worlds that far exceed imagination, and this is clearly unprecedented in a shooter. It's easy to see the great care and meticulous attention paid to each of the details that populate these worlds, both exterior and interior.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/8c83ff782dd0a355f1feedc1dd4bac865c8d80dc.png"][/img][/p][p]Ziplines are omnipresent in the worlds of LEGEND BATTLES. They allow players to transport themselves from one point to another, as well as access the rooftops of buildings. And by jumping from ziplines along the way, players can also access all levels of the various infrastructures by parachuting from their zipline. Likewise, players can climb everything, so it took a colossal amount of work to develop all the walls for climbing, all the roofs accessible after parachuting from a zipline. Also, the exteriors are fully playable in three dimensions, just like in real life for a special forces patrol.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/1a92c03312f9b2f5abbfaa7d13e5b37a43146f65.png"][/img][/p][p]We're in an Arab village in the middle of a rocky desert, just like in the movies. This village boasts an incredible level of detail, where every element has been carefully thought out, designed, and then crafted. Of course, this urban topology requires a unique combat strategy, and each architectural type corresponds to a different combat strategy. Also, in LEGEND BATTLES, adaptability is important because it's difficult to form habits in such different worlds.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/c4dc4b8e2e0f7d9d089426974640f277bf9032a2.png"][/img][/p][p]We're in an Arab village in the middle of a rocky desert, just like in the movies. This village boasts an incredible level of detail, where every element has been carefully thought out, designed, and then crafted. Of course, this urban topology requires a unique combat strategy, and each architectural type corresponds to a different combat strategy. Also, in LEGEND BATTLES, adaptability is important because it's difficult to form habits in such different worlds.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ac7cd43ac4cad30a1aea42e9bc07f39cbd446104.png"][/img][/p][p]If the enemies aren't here yet, then you can dream while riding your motorcycle leisurely across a frozen lake, fully equipped with two combat rifles, a guitar for melee combat, and a large backpack to carry all your gear and ammo. The motorcycle has a full tank of gas, so you can explore the surroundings.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/5c99175e4d56ee650a2dc26cda312cbc27b7b5ae.png"][/img][/p][p]This space base is entirely covered in snow, so the brightness is quite strong due to the reflection of light on the snow. Everything is snow-white, and all-white clothes would be perfect for camouflage, or even white rifles. This player chose bright colors to have fun with his friends, because a game is primarily about having fun, not necessarily winning. Also, remember that only one team wins, and all teams have fun.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/21a04a91d51ff2399c11a929c9a7b66d5d566dde.png"][/img][/p][p]The player races down a steep slope at full speed through the wilderness, as the vehicles in LEGEND BATTLES are as stable as in reality, if not more so, and it's a lot of fun. However, just like in real life, if your car rolls over several times, you'll lose the doors, hood, and trunk, and if you hit a wall, the bumper will come off. So drive skillfully, because these fantastic cars and motorbikes can reach incredible speeds of up to 400 km/h, yes even faster than F1 cars.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/c460358e913331f1ed8e7444ec7b7069493a3a24.png"][/img][/p][p]The sci-fi hangars are immense and house numerous spaceships as well as all their maintenance equipment. These hangars are lit in different colors depending on the area you are in. These hangars are complex with so many nooks and crannies and equipment that danger looms everywhere. It is almost impossible to run in these places without risking being shot down, and it is better to snake between covered areas, which is what makes these vast hangars so attractive.[/p][p] [/p][p]In this world rich in urban infrastructure, well-furnished interiors, equipped rooftops, and numerous zip lines to roam the multiple towers, players can practice solo to enjoy the first sensations of LEGEND BATTLES. And as a breaking news, we plan to open the LEGEND BATTLES Playtest before the end of July for your enjoyment.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]So, dear braves, come join our ranks, participate in the tough test battles during future Playtest sessions and follow us now on STEAM to loudly and clearly affirm your support for our fight.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you on LEGEND BATTLES, Braves.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Official website: [url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p]

These are dream super cars, and that's why you play LEGEND BATTLES because it's much more than a battle royale game.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ab25ac15ce9c1a7ac5cf7764b2d3443008880ad6.png"][/img][/p][p]And if you're a motorcycle enthusiast, you can ride fantastic machines reaching 395 km/h, even without a motorcycle license, because at such speeds, your license won't last long anyway. In LEGEND BATTLES, you can ride all types of motorcycles, such as racing motorcycles, but also urban motorcycles, customized motorcycles for your beautiful selfies, or even motocross motorcycles to go everywhere, including indoors by breaking down the front door because there is no limit to the fun with friends in LEGEND BATTLES.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/e09d82cd9bb2996ed72351fed09c9ba87fc4fc40.png"][/img][/p][p]Alien forests are magical places filled with wonders. It's an ideal place to make new friends even if the battles are intense.[/p][p]

Their small windows reduce passenger exposure, but at the same time, firing from these armored vehicles is less easy. These steel warriors are dressed in magnificent finery, the choices of which should satisfy most tastes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ec683aa5e36cbc66cb31dfd6ec50b87657ed09cd.png"][/img][/p][p]Custom bikes are magnificent, mechanized machines whose engine sound is true music to fans of this legendary brand. So once again, agility, speed, and dexterity are key to winning the battle.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/9dae19a6bab62eb04dd8cff9c329ca702e34ad53.png"][/img][/p][p]I'll let you discover this player in a dreamlike science fiction world, armed with a magnificent guitar on his back for hand-to-hand combat because LEGEND BATTLES is, above all, the realization of his dreams in magnificent worlds.[/p][p] [/p][p]We travel through these battlefields on foot, by motorcycle, by car, by truck, by helicopter, by flying suit, by parachute, and by zip line. [p]Greetings Braves,
[/p][p]I'm so thrilled to be with you again today.[/p][previewyoutube="oFiBTCpUI5Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p]During this fantastic flyover, you'll discover a small part of the wonders that abound in the battlefields of LEGEND BATTLES. With 300 megacities and thousands of buildings, each with its own interiors, the tour could take a very long time if we had to visit everything.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/8352627231d4a0884c892f2f408b7ccce2f85c21.png"][/img][/p][p]Let's visit some locations in the worlds of LEGEND BATTLE.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/e5e02f07a755dd6fb7cd9264894e1f832327fcc4.png"][/img][/p][p]The teleportation station allows you to travel through space in a fraction of a second, provided you master its exit out of range of snipers of all sides. So, this station can save you precious time, just as it can make you lose the game session because of a sniper in ambush. We are indeed in the middle of science fiction and it is entirely within the domain of the game to make us dream while having strong sensations because deep down this is what our players are looking for.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/f6b5d707130192ece15f54a8270625600c25c3ab.png"][/img][/p][p]We are at the entrance to a huge Inca temple where the fighting is extremely complex and dangerous, with numerous nooks and crannies scattered throughout. Running in such a place would be suicidal, but walking slowly makes it an ideal target for enemies. Furthermore, we know the physical situation in which we enter this mysterious temple, but we don't know the physical situation in which we will leave, and that's the whole mystery.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/00cd18ed41584789b1acf13975dae3578fdd36ce.png"][/img][/p][p]This basketball stadium is a pure marvel, and LEGEND BATTLES has many others of the same quality, if not better, due to their varied interiors. This stadium holds many surprises, and ambushes are easy, while offering a wide shooting range for experienced shooters.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/37bf39e0966d584c01aa02b41a75a07cfecac37f.png"][/img][/p][p]As you can see from this image, megacities are huge, and this city is just one example among hundreds of others. It's easy to get lost and shot down, with all the possibilities for ambushes outdoors, indoors, and on rooftops, even from spaceships and hot air balloons. And it's even worse in underground areas where danger is ever-present, with varying degrees of lighting. LEGEND BATTLES offers a vast, complex, and dense open world, never before seen in a shooter.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/26b99b9d9d4787f13a25fdc300d6b3313f4af932.png"][/img][/p][p]And yes, all these megacities are completely different, with very varied architectural styles, ranging from science fiction to luxurious modernity through cyberpunk, like these unfinished buildings. Of course, all the buildings are accessible and offer well-furnished or well-equipped interiors, and some are accessible on all floors, with all kinds of furniture and equipment, like these unfinished buildings. The possibilities of combat are then endless, and we no longer know where to turn to save our skin so the emotions are at their peak.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/9287f401b444ebf4a105c185403fdf912ae91c0c.png"][/img][/p][p]Well, here's a city built on several levels where you can easily get shot at, from above as well as from below. A large part of the city floats in the air. Moreover, with this third dimension, it's almost impossible to stay on your guard without risking being shot down without seeing it coming. Each megacity in LEGEND BATTLES requires its own strategy and tactics because there is no one-size-fits-all recipe, only new problems that require reflection, intelligence, and skill to survive in such a vast world, the taste of which is completely unknown to most players.[/p][p] [/p][p]Megacities are dense, vertical, complex, and multidimensional. They're full of hiding places, obstacles, and tactical cover. And remember, what makes LEGEND BATTLES unique is its total freedom of movement. Climb everywhere: trees, lampposts, billboards, cranes, telecommunications towers, watchtowers, water towers, wind turbines, elevated roads, bridges, all infrastructure and buildings to access rooftops or interiors by breaking a window. The world is fully climbable; each player can appear from anywhere and disappear just as quickly.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]We'd love to have you join us and are here to fully listen to you to finalize the game that best meets everyone's ambitions. To do so, please follow us on STEAM now.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you on LEGEND BATTLES, Braves.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Official website: [url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p]

notes.notes:
[p][b]OFFICIAL PRESS RELEASE – BIRTH OF THE LEGEND BATTLES COMMUNITY[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]BEIJING, June 26, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Hanxiang Beijing Studio is proud to announce the official launch of the LEGEND BATTLES community, centered around a unique and ambitious project: to create the very first hyper-realistic AAA Battle Royale game destined to shine worldwide.[/p][p] [/p][p]As one of the first studios to successfully develop with Unreal Engine 5.6 and powered by AWS GameLift, LEGEND BATTLES is much more than a next-gen Battle Royale: it's a statement of technological excellence and creativity. Set in a hyper-realistic 400 km² rocky desert open world populated by hundreds of futuristic megacities, players will experience an intense adventure driven by unparalleled visual and sound effects and captivating cinematics.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/d7340988078ece5a436c7e4535b239975adf70b6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]A NATIONAL PRIDE, A GLOBAL COMMUNITY[/b][/h3][p]For the first time, China and Europe aren't just following gaming trends: they’re creating them with Jianglin ZHANG, Chinese, Fawzi OUARETH, French and Eric MERGY, French, as their founders and their developments team in Beijing, China, their sales team in Paris, France. So, LEGEND BATTLES isn't just a game, it's a collective movement, a source of inspiration for a new generation of gamers and creators in China, in Europe and in the World.[/p][p]It's the triumph of audacity, passion, and dreams, embodied by a Sino-French team that has invested all its resources to push the boundaries of what's possible.[/p][p] [/p][p]We worked hard for 8 years to develop this app, having experienced almost all versions of Unreal Engine 4 and Unreal Engine 5 as well as all the evolutions of AWS GameLift. So, it was only natural for us to migrate to the latest and most advanced version of Unreal Engine 5.6, this version was released to the public on June 3, 2025, which allowed us to achieve unparalleled feats to date in our app.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thus, to create such a masterpiece, we collaborated with development studios, content creation studios, architecture and design firms from around the world to implement a vast 400 km2 map compacted into a 350 GB app. Yes, it's huge, and it's a titanic task that forced all team members to challenge themselves time and time again to map hundreds of megacities on a single map, but they persevered, and the results exceeded their wildest dreams.[/p][p] [/p][p]Today, it is time for us to expose ourselves under the lighting of the spotlights to make known our next-generation Battle Royale app in the world. Suffice to say that we are counting heavily on our compatriots to support this app, which will certainly become one of the prides of our countries. So, we call on all gamers to mobilize, join this unique adventure, and fly the Chinese and European flags for video games around the world. LEGEND BATTLES is a national pride to build a global community![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/7d87dba6b9d89c8ffbc5ebb57c244ed4b926dfa7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]A COMMUNITY STRATEGY THAT UNITES AND REWARDS[/b][/h3][p]Our ambition is also to give back to those who support us. To each player who:[/p][p] [/p][p]• follows LEGEND BATTLES on STEAM,[/p][p]• adds LEGEND BATTLES to their wishlist on STEAM,[/p][p] [/p][p]We’ll offer premium skins and different collector skins which are sellable on the STEAM marketplace![/p][p] [/p][p]Please contact us on our official website [/p][p][url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p][p] at “Contact” or by email at the following address: [/p][p][url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/d5ce5edcc204528fcea445566da35a94844c6bf7.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]A BREATHTAKING GAMING EXPERIENCE[/b][/h3][p]LEGEND BATTLES is a AAA Battle Royale game app:[/p][p] [/p][p]• Vast 400 km2 sci-fi open world of mountainous deserts.[/p][p]• Hundreds of megacities interconnected by immense road networks.[/p][p]• Futuristic and cyberpunk urban architecture in very different styles.[/p][p]• Thousands of fully explorable buildings with all kinds of well-furnished interiors.[/p][p]• Millions of MetaHumans and clothing combinations, all interchangeable from head to toe.[/p][p]• Thousands of professional weapons ranging from RPG, flamethrowers, miniguns, to machine guns, rifles, pistols, grenades, and knives.[/p][p]• Thousands of destructible vehicles, including all kinds of cars, motorcycles, ATVs, trucks, armored vehicles and helicopters.[/p][p]• Total immersion thanks to spatialized sound effects, gigantic rocky desert environments, and breathtaking cinematics.[/p][p] [/p][p]And above all: this is just the beginning.[/p][p]We want to build the universe of tomorrow with you, dear players.[/p][p] 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/81f9952d30e66a1982183b1b97db012f5a20db2f.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h3][b]JOIN THE GLOBAL MOVEMENT[/b][/h3][p]Available for free on STEAM in September 2025, LEGEND BATTLES is a collective adventure, an invitation to build together a world of freedom, beauty, and strategy.[/p][p]This game brings together all cultures, all passions, all energies—and we’re its beating heart.[/p][p] [/p][p]“We are LEGEND BATTLES. YR2 – You’re too.”[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/4b0ee797576ad235f968f4367fcf339eb8ff1253.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url]
