notes.title: Battle Royale in the sci-fi megacity of Antevorta
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Braves,
[/p][p]I'm so happy to be back with you today.[/p][previewyoutube="wcYSXK7AJ3c;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Today, the fighting is taking place in the megacity of Antevorta, which is part of a gigantic megalopolis consisting of four megacities named Caelus, Epona, Antevorta, and Libitina. In Roman mythology, Antevorta (also called Porrima or Prorsa) is a goddess associated with the future and childbirth.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/a99d313cc4f1806a2084222177a128a4d5e9398e.png"][/img][/p][p]Antevorta's exteriors offer a wide variety of urban infrastructure, including wide, high suspended pedestrian bridges, towering skyscrapers, and lush vegetation with impressive street furniture. All buildings in the city house cyberpunk interiors and are densely packed with various furniture. The roofs of these tall buildings were designed for high-altitude combat, and access is via dizzying zip lines.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ce32a181d52353baccbdc01f07ebaca735c84342.png"][/img][/p][p]The player is injured, but manages to defend himself and eliminate his enemy with his submachine gun. In this first-person perspective screenshot, we can clearly see that the enemy is well targeted. You'll find out who will shoot first by watching the video, which was filmed entirely with the LEGEND BATTLES app.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/0f476e20b03d4d26128325e5a3a70de18d9468cb.png"][/img][/p][p]Team players have a distinct advantage over solo players. Their teammates can revive them with a 10-second medical assist, but during those 10 seconds, they become an easy target because they can neither defend themselves nor move, otherwise they'll have to restart the 10-second assist from the beginning.[/p][p]If their teammates arrive too late, they can grab the respawn chip and take it to a resurrection station. This process is much riskier because snipers like to wait for other players at the resurrection station, but if successful, the teammate is parachuted onto the battlefield from a hover taxi. The player must then rush to greet his teammate first because this parachutist will hit the ground without any weapon, which makes his defense impossible, while he collects weapons, ammunition and protective equipment that are strewn across the ground.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/b46713e7f1e0c7262bd7c901cabc4a51501ccf4c.png"][/img][/p][p]Handheld flamethrowers have a range of about 20 to 40 meters and a flame duration of a few seconds. This player is therefore in a risky position, as the flames can still reach them. But in a battle royale, nothing is certain, as everything can change from one second to the next, and the most important thing is agility, intelligence, and combat skills. Therefore, the risk can be calculated to try to take down the opponent armed with a flamethrower, and the video will explain what happened.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/78647602a00382fb095552a076fd7fce05dff9a3.png"][/img][/p][p]This helicopter finds itself in a very delicate situation, as its turbine catches fire following a sniper's precise shots. There is no hesitation, and its passengers must jump from the helicopter, which will explode at any moment. This passage clearly shows that players are never safe, as everything can change, even in a seemingly safe helicopter. Indeed, many weapons can bring down a helicopter, such as an RPG, a grenade launcher, a minigun, or a grenade thrown from the roof of a building. And when the passengers jump from the helicopter, the sniper is sure not to stop there and will shoot down as many of the parachuted passengers as possible.[/p][p] [/p][p]Antevorta has many stadiums such as a huge outdoor tennis stadium, a vast indoor basketball stadium, a famous boxing arena, a large ice hockey stadium, an indoor Olympic swimming pool, a football stadium with a beautiful outdoor lawn and its inhabitants love to frequent their cyberpunk train station which hosts high-speed hovercraft trains.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the intense spectacle of the battles in this video in Antevorta and[/p][p] [/p][p]Please follow us on STEAM to realize together the game of your dreams.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you on LEGEND BATTLES, Braves.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Official website: [url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Full gameplay in the vast megacity of Latona
notes.notes: [p]Greetings Braves,[/p][p] [/p][p]We are proud to present the full gameplay of LEGEND BATTLES in the vast megacity of Latona, recorded entirely within our LEGEND BATTLES app on PC with RTX 3060 graphics cards.[/p][previewyoutube="H_DXlV8fNAk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Latona is the Roman equivalent of the Greek goddess Leto. She is a Titaness and the mother of the deities Apollo and Diana (Artemis in Greek) by Jupiter (Zeus in Greek). Latona is primarily known for her motherhood and the stories surrounding the birth of her children, often involving Hera's (Juno's) jealousy and persecution of her. [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/19fdbe739b2efa4624e3c2d0bcdb6612fc587ce2.png"][/img][/p][p]Latona is a vast science-fiction megacity with extensive infrastructure, and every building is filled with interiors. All the building roofs are furnished for combat, and the wide roads allow vehicles to travel at high speeds.[/p][p] [/p][p]It's remarkable to note that our racing cars can reach speeds of up to 405 km/h and our racing motorcycles can reach speeds of up to 395 km/h. Granted, even in most racing games, vehicles don't reach such speeds, but our developers have achieved the impossible based on our extensive experience.[/p][p] [/p][p]You'll see that the fighting is intense, and survival requires strategy, intelligence, skills and speed, as the range of weapons and vehicles is immense.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/fe8e7d85b059639453aad1a7e1ed55047bea0313.png"][/img][/p][p]Gas grenades are deadly if you're already injured, and you should dodge them anyway because your health will decrease considerably, and if a sniper injures you right after this grenade, well, it's over for you.[/p][p]A classic strategy is to fire a fragmentation grenade that will injure your enemies, if not kill them, then immediately fire a gas grenade that will finish them off. It's a nearly foolproof technique.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/481ffd6aad4a5482f4ad6ff3a778a0b3ed4f8b1f.png"][/img][/p][p]The flamethrower spreads terror everywhere. Some players even lose their reflexes when exposed to the enemy flamethrower. It's very impressive, but if you react quickly and smartly to a flamethrower attack then it's possible to escape while losing a large portion of your health. Also, the medical kit is essential after such an attack to heal yourself from cover.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/8e0e4e118084bc8690f9f0983e94aa96fb460f99.png"][/img][/p][p]Submachine gun fire will first explode the wheels, destroy part of the vehicle, then the vehicle will catch fire if its sensitive parts are hit like the fuel tank and the engine to finally explode completely after some time. Also, when the vehicle catches fire, you must quickly move away from it but the enemies are waiting for you and are well prepared to shoot you down. Also a solution to escape is to throw smoke grenades which will prevent your enemies from targeting you but this will not prevent them from shooting randomly in the smoke to try to reach you. Agility, intelligence and strategy will be the key words to your success during this battle royale.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/acb8af10318b26eedac6e42d80cd5036f21c0849.png"][/img][/p][p]And yes, experienced shooters don't even need a scope to hit their targets, so aiming is much faster and allows them to hit multiple targets in record time. Moreover, if this shooter shoots their target multiple times, the result is definitive.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]LEGEND BATTLES is inclusive; everyone is welcome, and you'll have fun while making new friends.[/p][p] [/p][p]Enjoy the intense spectacle of the battles in this video in Latona and[/p][p] [/p][p]Please follow us on STEAM to realize together the game of your dreams.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you on LEGEND BATTLES, Braves.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Official website: [url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: First battles in the sci-fi megacity of Latona
notes.notes: [p]Greetings Braves,[/p][p] [/p][p]I'm so happy to be able to present the first video of our gameplay to you today in the immense science-fiction megacity of Letona.[/p][previewyoutube="qAVMDa-lUfk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Latona is one of 300 megacities and megalopolis scattered across the vast world of 400 km2 made up of rocky mountain desert.  [/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/760dfeda6f2f333102233ec08248252491531d85.png"][/img][/p][p]You will see combat with various weapons outdoors, indoors, on rooftops, from sports cars, racing motorcycles, helicopters. In this first video, we present limited fights so that you can gradually enter the world of LEGEND BATTLES. In the very near future, the battles will quickly intensify to give you a small glimpse of the enormity of LEGEND BATTLES in all its aspects. Thank you for following us on STEAM to stay informed; we will now communicate almost daily.[/p][p] [/p][p]You'll see that the fighting is intense, and survival requires strategy, intelligence, skills and speed, as the range of weapons and vehicles is immense.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/09f62dd8dc2c5f1e0e465f21ee03dfe444e22398.png"][/img][/p][p]Incendiary grenades, like Molotov cocktails, cause enormous damage, especially to vehicles, because the fuel tank and the engine are sensitive areas that can cause the vehicle to explode. Interiors can also become a trap when in flames and walking through the flames to escape can become deadly and certainly very detrimental to health.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/4b2868959d09b5be09ac00a2bc3bdb9996be380a.png"][/img][/p][p]All buildings have well-equipped rooftops with access, so shooters are a constant danger with their sniper rifles. Outside, walking slowly is suicidal and it is imperative to run between cover locations as snipers will do you no favors.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/e4d07a15e50922f0b8b30911026408185345a63a.png"][/img][/p][p]Pistols and revolvers remain formidable close combat weapons, so don't neglect them and learn to handle them well because they can become lifesaving in many cases. You will be better equipped to face danger with your two rifles, your pistol, your grenades and your combat knives.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/09642af48091e264b559701acfd7d4061097f5bc.png"][/img][/p][p]Grenades are not easy on vehicles because they cause a double explosion that is fatal in many cases. The first explosion comes from the grenade, and the second from the vehicle itself. Additionally, a stationary vehicle becomes easier prey to shoot its passengers if they stay nearby for protection. In fact, this protection can also prove fatal due to the vehicle's fuel.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]LEGEND BATTLES is inclusive; everyone is welcome, and you'll have fun while making new friends.[/p][p] [/p][p]Enjoy the intense spectacle of the battles in this video in Latona and[/p][p] [/p][p]Please follow us on STEAM to realize together the game of your dreams.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you on LEGEND BATTLES, Braves.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Official website: [url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: LEGEND BATTLES publishes its press release with PR Newswire
notes.notes: [p][b]LEGEND BATTLES: the next-gen Battle Royale that reinvents the genre on UE 5.6 across 400 km2[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]BEIJING, China, May 9, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Hanxiang Studio today unveiled LEGEND BATTLES, a hyper-realistic, next-generation AAA Battle Royale game app designed to deliver an immersive and accessible gaming experience for all. Scheduled for release on STEAM in September 2025, LEGEND BATTLES promises to redefine the standards of the genre.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/05d98f755244b392f269cd128d603ec1429cd6f1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]A HUGE MAP FOR AN UNPRECEDENTED EXPERIENCE[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Powered by Unreal Engine 5.6, LEGEND BATTLES features a 400-square-km map featuring hundreds of sci-fi cyberpunk metropolises, each with unique interiors, scattered across mountainous deserts and connected by a dense road network. This vast expanse offers players unparalleled freedom of exploration and total immersion in a rich and detailed world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/7096cd45fc4e76c26f7f0e94d9af4d483c29c5d2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]ACCESSIBILITY AND DIVERSITY FOR ALL PLAYERS[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]LEGEND BATTLES is accessible to players of all skill levels. With tens of thousands of customizable metahuman avatars and interchangeable clothing items, destructible vehicles, and precise weapons, each player can create a unique experience tailored to their playstyle.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/2de1af8a5a854c25307ce68fde8ea9ad6819ea54.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]A VISION DRIVEN BY EXPERIENCE[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]The founders of Hanxiang Studio, building on their success with Boobuz - a mapping app that reached over 50 million downloads in 2016 - invested tens of millions of dollars of their own money to bring Legend Battles to life. Their expertise in geographic information systems and global mapping with 200 countries has enabled the creation of a world so vast that it is impossible to fully explore, even after a year of intensive play.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/4c77c7f6aa0b43c3d6b98d8efc1402ed25128e9b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]TOTAL IMMERSION IN A REALISTIC WORLD[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Thanks to the advanced hyperrealism of LEGEND BATTLES, players find themselves immersed in a virtual universe that mirrors reality, challenging their reflexes and adaptability. This realism is the result of Hanxiang Studio's experience in developing animated geospatial GNSS industrial metaverses, offering a gaming experience where every action has a tangible impact.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/b896adf5bc6dc4dffd015e9a7680d3ea886d6323.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]A GAME FOR FUN AND CONNECTIVITY[/b][/p][p]With over 30 years of entrepreneurial experience in app, Hanxiang Studio’s founders are committed to making shooting games accessible to all. LEGEND BATTLES provides a space where teens and adults can have fun together and bond within an inclusive and caring community.[/p][p] [/p][p]After years of dedication, patience, and personal investment, Jianglin  Zhang can now proudly see LEGEND BATTLES embody the excellence of Battle Royale games on the global stage.[/p][p][/p][p]Player and partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Official website: [url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]SOURCE Hanxiang Studio[/p]

notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="OU3EKDPjisw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hello ladies and gentlemen, my dear friends,[/p][p] [/p][p]It's my great pleasure and honour to welcome you today for a unique occasion: the official launch of LEGEND BATTLES. What we're going to present to you today is much more than a game. It's the result of several years of passion, hard work, and a deep desire to challenge the standards of Battle Royale. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/d309c45f021b8372b40c1bf3e4c0b5c8edf0158a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We build on our success with Boobuz - a mapping app that reached over 50 million downloads in 2016 and Michael Schumacher had been our ambassador in 2012. Now we invested tens of millions of dollars of finance to bring Legend Battles to life. Our team has a lot of experiences in developing animated geospatial GNSS industrial metaverses, offering a gaming experience where every action has a tangible impact.[/p][p] [/p][p]LEGEND BATTLES is a next-generation Battle Royale game. It's free, massive, and immersive. A 400 km² open world, more than 300 cyberpunk metropolises, all connected in a coherent, vibrant environment. Every detail has been carefully considered, every building can be explored. It's a true strategic playground where variety creates unique experiences with each game. And all this is powered by Unreal Engine 5.6, for stunning realism.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/f77919e63611e92f036da89832382cc8c17c3d2b.png"][/img][/p][p]Our expertise in geographic information systems and global mapping with 200 countries has enabled the creation of a world so vast that it is impossible to fully explore, even after a year of intensive play.[/p][p] [/p][p]LEGEND BATTLES isn't just another Battle Royale game. Thanks to the advanced hyperrealism of LEGEND BATTLES, players find themselves immersed in a virtual universe that mirrors reality, challenging their reflexes and adaptability. We are the first to offer a five-dimensional combat system: outdoors, indoors, underground, on rooftops, and in space. With its ziplines, respawn mechanics, thousands of avatars, and customizable weapons, every detail offers players a true platform for expression.[/p][p] [/p][p]Every building is fully explorable, with detailed interior environments that bring depth and realism to every encounter.[/p][p]Choose from a vast arsenal of weapons—heavy machine guns, revolvers, grenades, tactical knives, and more. Roam the battlefield in destructible vehicles including race cars, dirt bikes, off-roaders, and custom pickup trucks, all navigating an expansive road network across rugged desert mountains.[/p][p]LEGEND BATTLES isn't just a game; it's a total combat experience.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/3dfcd74efd7bd6179608c8458e5d2abca2be63f8.png"][/img][/p][p]But beyond technical innovation, this game is our national pride. It's a game designed, funded, and developed in China. A project driven by the vision of Hanxiang Co. Ltd.  It's the proof of our capability to dream big, create AAA titles, and deliver a game that rivals the best.[/p][p] [/p][p]Legend Battles is our pride and joy. It's our response to the world. It's the proof that China can create, innovate, and inspire.[/p][p] [/p][p]Esports Compatibility: LEGEND BATTLES was designed from the ground up to meet the demands of the esports scene. The game features a robust technical infrastructure with stable and scalable servers, balanced gameplay, and advanced observation tools for spectators and commentators. Custom modes are also available to allow for the organization of professional or community competitive tournaments. Our ambition: to make LEGEND BATTLES a benchmark on the international esports scene.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/a097b32cffae0c2cdb59d4e673b85b0a626ba9f3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]LEGEND BATTLES provides a space where teens and adults can have fun together and bond within an inclusive and caring community. LEGEND BATTLES is accessible to players of all skill levels. With tens of thousands of customizable metahuman avatars and interchangeable clothing items, destructible vehicles, and precise weapons, each player can create a unique experience tailored to their playstyle.[/p][p] [/p][p]LEGEND BATTLES is just the beginning. Our ambition is clear: to make this game a global benchmark for Battle Royale. The Steam release is scheduled for September 2025, with a gradual expansion to cross-platform play. Updates will enrich the game with new worlds, new weapons, and new quests. It's a living, breathing universe, constantly evolving.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/af0897abc99f632dbc2864e32ca992ee0ddcd437.png"][/img][/p][p]And above all, we want to build a global, open, and inclusive community where every player, regardless of skill level, can experience epic moments.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you very much! Thank you for your time, for listening, for your curiosity. LEGEND BATTLES is more than a project for us. It's a dream to come true, and today, it's in your hands.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/bbfcbdad45ad4ec4d0271e243e3ac58a8e0599c2.png"][/img][/p][p]Join the battle. Become a legend.
